Title: Senior Data Scientist, Buyer
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

The Buyer Domain at Vinted is dedicated to creating a seamless, delightful, and highly engaging experience for our members as they search, discover, and purchase items. Our challenge is unique: unlike standard e-commerce, our peer-to-peer catalog consists of hundreds of millions of entirely unique, single-inventory listings, with millions of new items uploaded daily. Connecting the right buyer with the perfect item in real-time is at the very core of Vinted's success.

To tackle this challenge at scale, we are looking to bring talented Data Scientists into the Buyer Domain's two highly specialized, ML-focused teams:


Search Relevance: This team is responsible for the retrieval and ranking systems that power search queries across all markets. Their mission is to ensure our members can effortlessly find exactly what they are looking for in Vinted's vast, unique catalog. The team's ownership and focus areas include multi-stage search ranking pipelines, query intent classification, semantic dense retrieval, and the integration of ML relevance models with content policy controls, all optimized for real-time execution.
Recommender Relevance: This team owns the Recommender System that powers Vinted’s Homepage Feed and which is responsible for driving a significant portion of all discoveries and purchases across the platform. Their mission is to inspire our members by surfacing highly personalized, engaging, and relevant recommendations. The team's ownership and focus areas include deep sequence-based user modeling, real-time candidate generation and ranking, and exploration of diverse member interests, built to handle massive scale and high-throughput constraints.


We will work with you to match your background, technical interests, and experience with the team where you can drive the most impact. Regardless of the team you join, you will be a proactive product partner. We work in a highly collaborative culture to align on technical approaches, and we validate all changes through rigorous offline evaluation and online A/B testing on our custom-built, in-house Experimentation platform.

In this position, you’ll


Build and optimize end-to-end machine learning models for retrieval, ranking, and personalization (e.g. gradient boosting, two-tower architectures, sequence models, and neural rerankers).
Partner closely with platform and software engineers to serve models directly in our search and recommendation engines, optimizing for high throughput and millisecond-level latency budgets.
Lead or contribute to collaborative design proposals for new modeling approaches, features, or training pipelines.
Define tracking requirements, perform offline evaluations, and design and analyze online A/B tests to measure real-world business impact.
Collaborate with Data, Engineering and Product stakeholders to identify product opportunities, translate business problems into ML objectives, and align on technical trade-offs.
Share knowledge, participate in peer reviews, and actively contribute to the growth and development of other scientists in the ML Guild and the Data Science & Analytics function.


About You

We are looking for Data Scientists who strike a balance between deep technical curiosity and practical business impact, engineers who are passionate about making second-hand fashion highly discoverable.


A strong collaborator with hands-on experience designing, training, and deploying machine learning models in a production environment (ideally within search, recommendations, or large-scale personalization).
High proficiency in Python and SQL. Experience with deep learning frameworks and gradient boosting libraries.
Solid understanding of modern information retrieval, Learning-to-Rank (LTR), semantic search, or sequence-based user preference modeling.
Experience or strong interest in high-performance model serving. Familiarity with search/vector engines like Vespa or Elasticsearch, and serving frameworks like Triton, is a plus.
Comfort working with massive datasets in modern cloud-based data warehouses.
Strong grasp of statistics, offline evaluation metrics, and online A/B testing methodologies.


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
25 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Frequent team-building events
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per working day
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€67.700—€91.500 EUR

Title: Medior AI Data Scientist
Description:
Word de beste versie van je zelf als Medior AI Data Scientist

Als Medior AI Data Scientist bij Sogeti zet je data en AI om in oplossingen die organisaties vooruithelpen. Je combineert analytische scherpte met de praktische toepassing van machine learning en Generative AI. Van de eerste klantvraag en een experiment tot implementatie en verbetering: jij blijft betrokken en maakt zichtbaar wat jouw oplossing oplevert.

Binnen onze Data & AI-community werk je met Data Scientists, AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineers en consultants. Je onderzoekt, bouwt en leert samen. Denk aan een voorspelmodel, documentanalyse of een kennisassistent met bedrijfsinformatie. Je krijgt ruimte om jouw vakkennis te verdiepen en die met collega's te delen.

Waarom jij het verschil maakt

Jij combineert een kritische blik op data met de drive om AI-oplossingen daadwerkelijk in productie te brengen. Je vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar concrete AI-usecases, hypotheses en meetbare doelen en onderzoekt welke data en aanpak het beste passen bij het gewenste resultaat. Daarbij analyseer en verrijk je data, ontwikkel je datasets voor training en evaluatie en houd je oog voor kwaliteit, privacy en verantwoord AI-gebruik.

Je bouwt modellen, prototypes en end-to-end AI-oplossingen in Python en combineert daarbij machine learning, Generative AI en Agentic AI. Denk aan toepassingen zoals RAG, documentverwerking, kennisassistenten en AI-agents die systemen en databronnen met elkaar verbinden. Je evalueert prestaties, onderzoekt foutpatronen, bias en betrouwbaarheid en zorgt ervoor dat oplossingen aantoonbare waarde leveren. Samen met Data Engineers en AI/ML Engineers realiseer je datapipelines, integraties en deployments. Ook na livegang blijf je betrokken: je monitort resultaten, verwerkt gebruikersfeedback en vertaalt nieuwe inzichten naar verbeteringen en doorontwikkeling van AI-oplossingen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:


Het vertalen van businessvraagstukken naar AI-usecases, hypotheses en meetbare resultaten.
Ontwikkelen van machine learning-, Generative AI- en Agentic AI-oplossingen.
Bouwen van end-to-end AI-oplossingen, van experiment en prototype tot productie.
Het evalueren van modellen op kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid, bias en businesswaarde.
Samenwerken met Data Engineers en AI/ML Engineers aan datapipelines, integraties en deployments.
Monitoren, verbeteren en doorontwikkelen van AI-oplossingen na livegang.


Hiermee word je de beste versie van jezelf


Je deelt ervaringen met vakgenoten en scherpt jouw aanpak aan tijdens communitydagen, workshops en inhoudelijke sessies.
Je verdiept je in AI, Advanced Analytics en MLOps en ontwikkelt je verder in consultancy en communicatie.
Je groeit op een manier die bij jou past, als inhoudelijk specialist of richting lead consultant.
Je kunt collega's begeleiden en bijdragen aan nieuwe AI-diensten. Zo bouw je aan jouw expertise en aan die van je team.


Je kunt daarnaast rekenen op

Je kunt daarnaast rekenen op


Een vast contract voor 32, 36 of 40 uur en een beloningsbudget tot €7.100 bruto per maand, inclusief vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsvergoeding;
Je kunt bij ons kiezen voor de manier van reizen die het beste bij je past zoals een leaseauto (elektrisch), kilometervergoeding en je krijgt een NS-Business Card, of een combinatie daarvan;
We motiveren een actieve levenstijl daarom bieden wij daarbovenop een fietsleaseplan via Lease A Bike;
26 vakantiedagen met optie tot bijkopen, een onkostenvergoeding en een jaarlijkse bonus vanaf C-Grade;
Met onze Benefits at Work krijg je kortingen bij webshops zoals bol.com, HEMA en Wehkamp, én voordeel op activiteiten, elektronica en meer;
Een sterk inhouse L&D-programma, een onbeperkt opleidingsbudget en actieve vakinhoudelijke communities waar kennisdeling en groei centraal staan;
Ruimte om bij te dragen aan een duurzamere toekomst via een duurzaamheidsbudget en flexregelingen;
Aandacht voor (mentale) gezondheid, met initiatieven zoals OpenUp, ouderschapstrainingen, vitaliteitswebinars en een korting op je sportabonnement;
Toegang tot inspirerende events zoals Women@Sogeti en SoPlay, waar tech en verbinding samenkomen.


Jouw talenten en ervaring


Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau en 2 tot 4 jaar ervaring als AI Data Scientist of in een vergelijkbare toegepaste AI-rol.
Je hebt een stevige basis in statistiek, machine learning en data-analyse. Je onderbouwt modelkeuzes en herkent overfitting, vertekening en informatielekken tussen train- en testdata.
Werkt met Python voor dataverwerking en modelontwikkeling, gebruikt versiebeheer en maakt experimenten reproduceerbaar en code testbaar.
Je hebt ML- of AI-oplossingen gebouwd voor concrete vraagstukken, wilt Generative AI toepassen en werkt met engineers aan implementatie in moderne data- of cloudomgevingen.
Neemt eigenaarschap, maakt resultaten en beperkingen begrijpelijk voor stakeholders en beheerst de Nederlandse taal op C1-niveau.
Ervaring met LLMs, RAG, embeddings, AI-agents, GenAI-evaluaties, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, SQL, R of MLOps is mooi meegenomen. Dat geldt ook voor AI-diensten in Azure, AWS of GCP. Je hoeft niet iedere tool te beheersen.


Meer over Sogeti

Bij Sogeti geef je richting aan jouw groei, als vakgenoot en als mens. Je werkt aan klantopdrachten, leert van collega's en vindt ruimte voor jouw eigen perspectief. Iedereen is welkom en kan zichzelf zijn.

Klaar om impact te maken?

Solliciteer als Medior AI Data Scientist. Twijfel je of deze rol bij je past? We denken graag met je mee. Neem gerust contact op voor meer informatie. Met Python, LLM's, RAG en machine learning bouwen we generatieve en voorspellende toepassingen voor onze financiële dienstverlening: AI-assistenten, kennisontsluiting, documentanalyse, speech-to-text, en modellen waarmee we beter voorspellen en efficiënter werken.

Je krijgt daarbij niet altijd een uitgetekend technisch vraagstuk. Je onderzoekt, stelt vragen, maakt keuzes en brengt een oplossing verder: van eerste experiment naar iets dat betrouwbaar, verantwoord en onderhoudbaar in productie draait.




Zo werken we

We werken in sprints van twee weken, maar niet alles ligt vooraf vast. We maken bewust tijd voor onderzoek en experimenten: nieuwe technologie verkennen, kennis delen en ideeën bouwen en testen. Dat is nodig in een vakgebied dat voortdurend verandert.

We vinden het interessanter dat je begrijpt wat er onder de motorkap gebeurt dan dat je ieder framework kunt afvinken. Werk je met Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph of agentic AI, dan sluit dat mooi aan.

ontwikkel je machine learning- en GenAI-oplossingen met Python, LLM's en RAG
werk je aan retrieval, prompting, evaluatie en modelkeuzes
breng je prototypes naar stabiele toepassingen, inclusief monitoring op kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid
onderzoek je nieuwe mogelijkheden, waaronder agentic AI
neem je privacy, AI-wetgeving en verantwoord gebruik mee in het ontwerp, niet achteraf
leg je technische keuzes uit aan collega's binnen én buiten IT

Je werkt op projecten waar data echt verschil kan maken. Denk aan forecasting, klantgedrag, risicoanalyse, optimalisatie of automatisering. Wij kijken samen welke opdracht past bij jouw ervaring, interesses en gewenste ontwikkelrichting.




Jij als gangmaker

Voor jou is een model geen einddoel, maar een middel om betere beslissingen te nemen. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar patronen in data, maar ook kritisch op de toepasbaarheid van modellen in de praktijk. Je vertaalt complexe analyses naar begrijpelijke inzichten en weet stakeholders mee te nemen in wat een model doet, waarom het werkt en wat de impact is op hun business.




Wat ga je doen?

Als Data Scientist werk je aan uiteenlopende data science vraagstukken binnen cloud-gedreven omgevingen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

Ontwikkelen van voorspellende modellen en machine learning-oplossingen met Python.
Toepassen van algoritmes voor forecasting, classificatie, clustering en optimalisatie.
Analyseren van complexe datasets en vertalen naar bruikbare inzichten.
Operationaliseren van modellen in cloudomgevingen zoals Azure, AWS of GCP
Samenwerken met Data Engineers om data pipelines en feature sets beschikbaar te maken.
Sparren met stakeholders over businessvraagstukken en data science toepassingen.
Verbeteren en monitoren van model performance in productie-omgevingen (MLOps waar van toepassing).
Afhankelijk van de opdracht werk je met technologieën zoals: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn), TensorFlow of PyTorch (afhankelijk van opdracht), SQL voor data-extractie en
analyse, Azure Machine Learning / AWS SageMaker, Databricks voor data science en modelontwikkeling, Cloud data platformen zoals Azure , AWS of GCP) en Git en CI/CD pipelines (waar van toepassing)

Salaris tussen €3.500 en €5.720 bruto per maand.
Direct contract voor onbepaalde tijd.
Leaseauto met tankpas, ook privé te gebruiken.
25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld.
Goede pensioenregeling, waarbij i4talent 2/3 van de premie betaalt.
Toegang tot de i4talent Academy met online en klassikale trainingen (inhoud en soft skills) via onder andere NIVE en Coursera, inclusief erkende certificaten.
Persoonlijke begeleiding van een Fieldmanager en Happy professional manager.
Afwisselende opdrachten bij fintechs, logistieke bedrijven, corporates en scale-ups.
Events: van inhoudelijke sessies tot trips, bootdagen en borrels.

Je hebt een sterke analytische basis en weet hoe je data science praktisch toepast binnen organisaties.

Een hbo- of wo-diploma in een kwantitatieve richting (bijv. Data Science, AI, Wiskunde, Econometrie).
Minimaal 2-3 jaar ervaring als Data Scientist of in een vergelijkbare analytische/ ML rol.
Sterke ervaring met Python en data science libraries.
Ervaring met supervised en unsupervised machine learning technieken.
Ervaring met cloudplatformen zoals Azure of AWS.
Begrip van modelvalidatie, performance metrics en datavoorbereiding.
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en vermogen om complexe materie uit te leggen.
Vloeiende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
Rijbewijs en bereidheid om te reizen binnen de Randstad.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Over het Bedrijf

Werk mee aan de toekomst van de grootste haven van Europa, Rotterdam, door complexe operationele data om te zetten in voorspellende inzichten die daadwerkelijk impact maken.

We beheren, exploiteren en ontwikkelen het Rotterdamse haven- en industriegebied en zijn verantwoordelijk voor het handhaven van een veilige en vlotte afhandeling van de scheepvaart. We zijn trots op de haven van nu en creëren samen met onze partners de haven van de toekomst. Met vooruitziende blik, streven we naar een klimaatvriendelijke, inclusieve én veilige haven.




Als Data Scientist maak je deel uit van het team Digital Port Performance. Dit team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega's met uiteenlopende nationaliteiten en achtergronden. Ons doel is om met digitale oplossingen de strategie van de haven te realiseren en de prestaties te verbeteren. We gebruiken data en analytics om knelpunten te identificeren en werken samen met klanten en partners aan oplossingen. Deze oplossingen bouwen we meestal niet zelf, maar we coördineren en begeleiden de ontwikkeling ervan.

Wij werken samen met een ecosysteem van start-ups, scale-ups, leveranciers en kennisinstellingen.

Omdat digitalisering een belangrijk strategisch thema is, rapporteert het team rechtstreeks aan de CEO. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van de afdelingen Commercial, Asset Management, Environmental Management, Strategy, Marketing & Com




Over de Rol

Als Data Scientist bouw je end-to-end analytische oplossingen, waarbij je gebruikmaakt van Azure, Databricks en geavanceerde machine learning om de prestaties van de haven op grote schaal te verbeteren. Je werkt samen met een multidisciplinaire analytics-community om jouw modellen te vertalen naar duidelijke, bruikbare inzichten voor stakeholders binnen de hele organisatie.




Verantwoordelijkheden




Ontbrekende gestructureerde en ongestructureerde data verzamelen en integreren om inzicht in operationele processen te vergroten, waarbij alle data-inname voldoet aan de geldende data governance-richtlijnen en Medallion Architecture-standaarden binnen het Azure Lakehouse.
Ontwikkelen en in productie brengen van verklarende en voorspellende modellen (zoals regressiemodellen, machine-learningmodellen en optimalisatiesolvers), van proof-of-concepts in lokale notebooks tot dbt-modellen en GitHub-beheerde code binnen centrale CI/CD-processen.
Ontwerpen van robuuste datapijplijnen met Databricks en dbt, zodat datasets schoon, accuraat en geïntegreerd zijn voor dynamische inzichten via Power BI, Genie AI/BI en Databricks Dashboards.
Optreden als data translator door de juiste vragen te stellen, verwachtingen af te stemmen en complexe modellen en technische bevindingen te vertalen naar duidelijke visualisaties en managementpresentaties voor business- en programmamanagers.
Samenwerken binnen de gehele waardeketen, onder meer met architecten en platform engineers, en intern met Data Stewards en Data Specialists, om de data-infrastructuur en havenbrede standaarden continu te verbeteren.




Kwalificaties




Afgeronde bachelor- of masteropleiding, bij voorkeur in een STEM-richting (Science, Technology, Engineering & Mathematics).
Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie op het gebied van data science en/of data analytics.




Vereiste Vaardigheden




Aantoonbare programmeervaardigheden in Python en SQL voor dataverzameling (inclusief werken met API's en JSON), datamodellering, datavisualisatie en het ontwikkelen van machine-learning- en GenAI-modellen in cloudomgevingen.
Aantoonbare kennis van statistiek, econometrie en de concepten achter data-science-technieken.
Bewezen vermogen om als data translator op te treden en de brug te slaan tussen technische datateams en business stakeholders. Je kunt requirements ophalen, feedback verwerken, resultaten presenteren en projecten opleveren die gericht zijn op bedrijfswaarde.
Kennis van de Nederlandse taal op minimaal B2/C1 niveau is een harde eis voor deze functie. Gedegen kennis van de Engelse taal is een pré.




Voorkeursvaardigheden




Competenties zoals probleemoplossend vermogen, effectieve communicatie, klantgerichtheid en kwaliteitsgerichtheid.




Beloningsbereik en Compensatiepakket




Afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring bieden wij een startsalaris tot € 5.172 bruto per maand op basis van een 36-urige werkweek, met doorgroeimogelijkheden tot € 6.465 bruto per maand. Bovenop dit salaris krijg je 19,6% flexibel budget, zelf naar eigen keuze in te richten wat je met dit bedrag wil doen. Spaar het op, wellicht extra pensioen of geef het bijv. uit aan extra vrije dagen, wat jij wil en belangrijk vindt.




Gelijke Kansen Verklaring




Een integriteitsonderzoek en online screening maken deel uit van de selectieprocedure. Valicare voert namens het Havenbedrijf deze screening uit.

Title: AI/ML Engineer / Data Scientist
Description:
AI/ML Engineer / Data Scientist – Search & Generative AI




About the Organization

Our client is a leading financial organization with a strong digital focus, where innovation, data, and technology play a central role. Millions of users rely on its digital platforms, applications, and online services every day. To continuously enhance the user experience, the organization invests heavily in intelligent search capabilities and AI-driven solutions.




As part of an ongoing digital transformation, the organization is building a next-generation search architecture that combines semantic search, embeddings, machine learning, and generative AI technologies.




About the Environment

You will join a multidisciplinary Agile team consisting of experienced software developers, a Scrum Master, and a Product Owner. The team has a strong technical foundation and works collaboratively to develop innovative search and AI solutions.




The department is focused on delivering an exceptional digital experience through advanced content platforms, intuitive navigation, and intelligent search capabilities. The solutions you develop will be used across websites, applications, and internal platforms that serve large numbers of users on a daily basis. The environment encourages innovation, knowledge sharing, and experimentation while operating within well-defined governance and compliance frameworks.




Responsibilities.

As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing intelligent search and AI solutions. You will translate complex business challenges into scalable data products and contribute to the evolution of a future-proof search ecosystem. Your responsibilities will include:




Developing and training machine learning models for semantic search and personalization.
Optimizing embedding models and hybrid search solutions within Elasticsearch environments.
Researching and implementing Large Language Model (LLM) use cases, including summarization, metadata generation, and other AI-driven applications.
Translating business requirements into actionable data products and insights.
Designing dashboards and visualizations to communicate insights effectively.
Collaborating closely with developers, the Product Owner, and Scrum Master to deliver scalable solutions.
Monitoring, evaluating, and improving model performance, quality, and explainability.
Supporting AI governance, compliance initiatives, and risk management processes.
Coaching team members in data-driven ways of working and helping establish robust data practices.




Requirements

We are looking for a Data Scientist who combines strong technical expertise with the ability to engage stakeholders and communicate complex concepts effectively. Required Qualifications:

Minimum of 4 years of experience in Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP)
Proven expertise in information retrieval, semantic search, embeddings, and Large Language Model integration.
Experience with Elasticsearch and hybrid search architectures.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with search evaluation methodologies and metrics such as nDCG, MAP, and MRR.
Advanced Python programming skills.
Experience working in notebook environments, such as Databricks.
Ability to balance innovation with governance, compliance, and risk management requirements.




Preferred Qualifications

Experience with machine learning model monitoring and explainability.
Knowledge of CI/CD practices and software development best practices.
Experience with dashboarding, data visualization, and storytelling.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and multidisciplinary teams.
Basic knowledge of Java is considered a plus.




What You Will Receive

An opportunity to work in an innovative, data-driven environment with significant business impact.
Exposure to cutting-edge technologies in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Search, and Generative AI.
Collaboration with highly skilled professionals in multidisciplinary Agile teams.
A culture that encourages continuous learning, innovation, and professional development.
The opportunity to contribute to large-scale digital products used by millions of users.
Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with your experience and expertise.
A key role in shaping the future of intelligent search and AI-driven digital experiences.

Title: Data Scientist LLM
HTML:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Een mooie toekomst voor iedereen—dat is waar we bij Sopra Steria naartoe werken. Met meer dan 51.000 collega’s in bijna 30 landen zijn we één van de grootste leveranciers van digital solutions in Europa. We geloven dat niet enkel technologie transformatie aandrijft. Maar dat mensen de kern van verandering vormen Daarom staan mensen ook centraal in alles wat we doen en kun je bij ons zowel individueel als in een team uitblinken.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Wij zoeken een innovatieve en ervaren Data Scientist gespecialiseerd in Large Language Models (LLMs) om ons dynamische team in Nieuwegein te versterken. In deze rol bevind je je aan de voorhoede van het ontwikkelen en implementeren van geavanceerde Natural Language Processing (NLP)-oplossingen, waarbij je de brug slaat tussen nieuwe technologieën en concrete businessbehoeften.

Voor een medior-profiel zoeken we doorgaans iemand met 3+ jaar relevante, praktische ervaring; voor een senior-profiel 5+ jaar. Los van deze aantallen nodigen we ook uitstekende kandidaten met sterke technische expertise, impactvolle projecten en aantoonbare kennisdiepte uit om te solliciteren, ongeacht exact aantal ervaringsjaren.

In deze rol ga je:

  • Geavanceerde machine learning-modellen ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren, met focus op LLM’s en NLP-toepassingen;
  • Samenwerken met multidisciplinaire teams om complexe businessproblemen data-gedreven op te lossen;
  • Onderzoek doen naar state-of-the-art LLM-technieken en bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe algoritmes;
  • Grote tekstuele datasets voorbereiden en features engineeren voor NLP-taken;
  • Machine learning-modellen optimaliseren en implementeren in productieomgevingen;
  • Junior teamleden begeleiden en technische ondersteuning bieden bij NLP- en LLM-projecten;
  • Op de hoogte blijven van de laatste ontwikkelingen in LLMs en GenAI, en inzichten delen met het team en klanten;
  • Bijdragen aan de continue verbetering van onze data science-processen en methodologieën.

Functie-eisen

  • Masterdiploma (of vergelijkbaar) in Computer Science, Statistiek, Toegepaste Wiskunde, Kunstmatige Intelligentie of een verwante discipline;
  • Medior: 3+ jaar / Senior: 5+ jaar ervaring met het leveren van productieklare data-scienceoplossingen in een commerciële of publieke omgeving, met sterke focus op NLP en LLMs;
  • Gevorderde vaardigheid in Python en ervaring met productieklare code schrijven;
  • Grondige kennis van LLMs en embeddings (zoals GPT, BERT) en hun toepassingen;
  • Bekendheid met deep learning frameworks zoals TensorFlow of PyTorch;
  • Ervaring met NLP-specifieke tools en libraries (bijv. LangChain, HuggingFace, spaCy);
  • Vaardig in het werken met containerisatie- en orkestratietools (bijv. Docker, Helm, Kubernetes);

  • Kennis van modeloptimalisatie-technieken en deploymentstrategieën;
  • Uitstekende probleemoplossende vaardigheden en een constructieve aanpak van uitdagingen;
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen complexe concepten uit te leggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische doelgroepen;
  • Vloeiend in Nederlands én Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op professioneel niveau;
  • Passie voor continue verbetering, kennisdeling en het vooroplopen in het snel evoluerende data-scienceveld.

Aanvullende informatie

Je wordt onderdeel van een grote naam in de techwereld, bekend om AI-diensten, consultancy en softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt samen met hoogopgeleide professionals die lef tonen in hun aanpak en zich inzetten om uitzonderlijke resultaten te leveren. Voor deze specifieke rol maak je deel uit van ons Data Science & AI-practice team binnen de grotere Data area.

Binnen de Data area creëren we langdurige waarde voor onze klanten door data centraal te stellen. We helpen bedrijven wendbaar te blijven tijdens transities door data en technologie onderdeel te maken van zowel de dagelijkse operaties als de strategische besluitvorming. Zo helpen we onze klanten voorop te blijven lopen door de kracht van data. Onze ambitie is om organisaties te laten excelleren met data.

Je werkt in een hightech omgeving die volledig gericht is op kennis en innovatie, met een open, no-nonsense cultuur waarin initiatief wordt aangemoedigd. Het domein bestaat uit vijf practices: Data Governance & Data Management, Data Visualization, Data Science & AI, Data Engineering & Data Migrations en Spatial Intelligence - elk met een duidelijke identiteit en focus op inhoud en oplossingen. Er werken ruim 170 professionals in dit domein, ieder in de practice die het beste bij hun expertise en interesses past.

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een vast contract en een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4000,- en €6000,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur per week);
  • Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol.
  • Vakantiegeld van 8%;
  • Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten;
  • Een mobiliteitsregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatieve vervoersregeling, passend bij jouw situatie;
  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen aan- of te verkopen;
  • Flexibele hybride werkomstandigheden: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant, afhankelijk van de functie en de mogelijkheden binnen opdrachten;
  • Een thuiswerkpakket met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
  • Volop mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, certificeringen, kennissessies en inspirerende events;
  • Diverse sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van informele borrels tot sportieve en inhoudelijke evenementen;
  • Mogelijkheden voor fiscaal vriendelijke aflossing van jouw studieschuld;
  • Een uitgebreid aanbod aan voordelen via ons cafetariamodel, waaronder een fietsregeling, sportabonnementen, zonnepanelen en collectieve verzekeringen;
  • Een pensioenregeling met een werkgeversbijdrage en de mogelijkheid om vrijwillig aanvullende pensioenopbouw te realiseren.

In wat voor team kom je?

Wij hebben een fantastisch team. En in plaats van dat je ons alleen op papier hoeft te geloven: tijdens het sollicitatieproces ontmoet je het team, bijvoorbeeld tijdens een borrel, hackathon of codeersessie. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat je ziet hoe ons team werkt en dat er een goede klik is.

Als team doen we meer dan alleen algoritmes en code schrijven. We geven les aan de Hogeschool Utrecht (HU), werken aan gave producten, hebben maandelijkse hackathons, sportuitjes (zoals padel- en basketbalclinics) en teambijeenkomsten. We hechten waarde aan innovatie en wetenschap en dragen actief bij aan ons vakgebied; zo faciliteren we in 2025 bijvoorbeeld talks en posters op PyData, SEMANTiCS en CLIN.

Klinkt deze baan als iets voor jou? Klaar om samen met ons de wereld vorm te geven? Fantastisch! We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie.

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

Title: Data Scientist | Talent Program
HTML:
Let’s talk talent

You have talent. Ready to make impact. We know. We also know that making impact starts with that first contact between like-minded people who have the same drive to shape their future. We see you, with your skills, personality and dreams. Now let’s take it to even greater heights by means of one of our talent programs for master’s graduates.

We are Mploy Associates, a talent-focused consultancy firm ready to make not only our clients’ teams successful but also you. Your talent, our focus.


More specifically?

We are a consultancy firm specialized in the areas of data, finance, and analytics and work on a variety of projects like investment analyses, data engineering, quant modelling and much more. Our clients are banks, insurance companies, and asset managers and we are still expanding.


We help our clients build successful teams by providing the right skills, talents and know-how at the right place and time and developing ourselves continuously to stay successful. We believe that investing in talent through proven methods always pays out. Today we are proud to say that we are an international-driven company with more than 100 people and many top-tier clients who share the same vision.


How do you fit into this vision?

You will work as a Data Scientist for one of our clients with a special focus on your own development through one of our Talent Programs. Our Talent Programs are designed to accelerate your career from entry-level to medior+ level within 24 months. By means of certified training courses, coaching and intervision sessions our employees follow an above-average steep career curve. Successful graduation in our Talent Programs usually results in a permanent medior+ or senior position at one of our clients or where it becomes your responsibility to keep the team successful.


Your activities as a Data Analyst

From data collection and model development to stakeholder meetings and model calibrations: the activities of a data scientist are highly diverse. Your day-to-day responsibilities include:


  • Developing and refining research questions for further data analysis and modelling;
  • Merging tables and processing data in SQL, SAS and/or Python;
  • Carrying out relevant data quality analyses (e.g. trend, missing value, and extreme value analyses);
  • Interpretation of the data by means of pattern analyses and descriptive statistics;
  • Developing predictive models using common statistical and AI libraries;
  • Monitoring model performance;
  • Calibrating existing models on new datasets;
  • Documenting the modelling process and discussing this with relevant stakeholders.


On average you work 36 hours a week on a client project and you spend 4 hours a week on your own personal, professional and technical development in one of our Talent Programs.


What do we offer?

We offer the opportunity to become an expert in data analysis, in an environment where we train you to excel as a high-end professional. In addition, good working conditions are equally as important to us.


By offering free lunch at the office and regular fun team activities like escape rooms and fun dinners, we ensure a connected and social workplace. Also important; we will provide you with a public transport card and/or (electric) bike. All on us of course. Furthermore:


  • A salary of €3,850 for master's graduates, including holiday allowance and 13th-month salary;
  • Challenging work and projects for one of our top 200 clients;
  • 25 days of paid annual leave;
  • Half-day a week in-house professional and technical training combined with personal coaching;
  • Besides in-house training opportunities, an external development budget of €2,000 per year to obtain relevant certifications as FRM or CFA;
  • An international working environment with driven and ambitious colleagues from all over the world;
  • The opportunity to take your next career move as a medior at the client or Mploy Associates after successfully completing your development program;
  • Pro bono technical projects at socially relevant NGOs.


What are we looking for?

We are looking for graduates with different quantitative and data-related backgrounds, experiences, and passions. It speaks for itself that you are ambitious, self-reflective and dare to be confident in an authentic way.

Furthermore, you are energized by stakeholder management and are well adept at gathering reliable information. You use this in combination with a consultive mindset to make our clients more successful. Last but not least, you are eager to develop yourself on a personal, professional and technical level with our personalized in-house Talent Programs. To make this more specific:


  • You have 0-3 years of work experience and want to learn everything about data science;
  • You want to put into practice your skills that you have acquired during your master's in Data Science, Mathematics, Econometrics or another quantitative and data-related study;
  • You have a strong feel for data and data architecture, as much of the data science craft revolves around creativity and curiosity;
  • You do not hesitate to use your analytical skills to solve complex problems creatively and logically;
  • You work in a structured and precise manner to safeguard reliable results.


Interested?

For more information about our different positions and Talent Programs you can visit our website www.mployassociates.com. Want to know more about the vacancy? Use the apply button above or email us at careers@mployassociates.com from the moment you start your master’s so we can help you prepare for your dream career. We will be in touch.


Please note that unfortunately there is no point in applying when you do not live in the Netherlands or if you have more than 3 years of work experience. These applications will not be processed.


Are you interested in multiple positions at Mploy Associates? Apply for one position and mention the other position(s) in your motivation message. Together we will find the best match for you.

Title: Senior Data Scientist 5 - Media Science
Description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Our Content business is responsible for weighing trade-offs between budget, schedules, and quality across the movies and shows we produce all around the world. The Media Science DSE team uses data to help the business navigate those decisions with clarity. Our metric frameworks and analysis directly shape how we enable creative teams to produce the best movies and shows for our members.

EMEA is a growing hub within our broader Data & Insights org, and we are looking for a stunning Senior Data Scientist based in Amsterdam to join our growing Studio Production DSE team. In this role, you will partner with Product Management and cross-functional product teams, Finance & Strategy, and Content Operations & Innovation leadership to scale and innovate content creation workflows. Through thoughtful metric research and causal inference modeling, you will have the opportunity to directly influence decision-making around how we produce and innovate on global content production - helping Creatives bring their best vision to life on screen.

As a Senior Data Scientist in this space, you will:


Be the second Applied Inference Data Scientist in Media Science Data Science & Engineering, helping shape how the discipline shows up and drives impact in Studio Production
Be a strategic thought partner for Content & Business Product PMs, Content Operations & Innovation leaders and teams, Finance & Strategy, and AI Innovation & Strategy DSE – scoping ambiguous, greenfield questions and proposing data science approaches where no playbook exists
Identify metric research and causal inference opportunities to assess the impact of media innovation efforts and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of media creation
Help Studio navigate cost, time, and quality trade-offs by delivering research that connects production decisions to member and business outcomes
Own your research agenda end to end - from design and execution on causal analysis through to interpretation and dissemination
Present your research and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, translating complex analysis into decisions leadership can act on
Build and maintain strong partnerships with a variety of business and product stakeholders, working directly with them to introduce and influence data-informed ways of working
Collaborate with exceptional Data Scientists and Analytics Engineers in-region and globally to explore our operational data and uncover insights that help creative teams produce even better shows and movies for our members
Serve as a regional expert on Studio Data Science & Engineering, helping educate and connect regional offices to existing research and data solutions from across the team


About You


Advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or related quantitative field
5+ years of relevant experience with a variety of causal inference methods, including quasi-experimental designs and managing complexities around smaller sample sizes
Strong statistical knowledge and intuition, utilized in observational causal analysis and applied machine learning settings, with demonstrated business impact
An expert in SQL and Python
Proven track record wrangling data, performing exploratory data analysis, designing metrics and tests, building causal inference solutions, and articulating data stories to deliver meaningful business impact
Strong verbal and written communicator who can develop and deepen effective relationships with a wide variety of stakeholders and communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely to less technical audiences
A self-starter with a learning mindset who is exceptionally curious – eagerly diving into new spaces and bringing informed ideas to the table
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and a fast-paced environment; able to take ownership and thrive with minimal oversight and process
Thrilled about innovating in the Content Production domain via novel experimental techniques and comfortable taking (smart) risks in your work
Extensive experience within the EMEA region, adept at working across different cultures on a globally-distributed team, collaborating with fellow team members and partners to ideate on and deliver impactful research
Netflix culture resonates with you
Plus: Experience creating data products and dashboards such as Tableau
Plus: Designing and analyzing A/B tests


Culture

You will have the opportunity to impact the business in a meaningful way, working alongside smart people who love to solve hard problems, and who not only expect but also foster high performance. You will have the freedom to innovate, solve interesting problems, and influence decision-making in a fast-paced, exciting environment. You can learn more about our culture at jobs.netflix.com/culture.

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Title: Data Scientist/ML Engineer
Description:
Want to build data products that directly impact millions of viewers daily? From selecting Videoland thumbnails to optimizing search and forecasting churn, our Data Science team solves diverse, high-impact challenges. We’re looking for a Netherlands-based Data Scientist with 3+ years of experience in Python, modern MLOps (Databricks, Kubernetes), and end-to-end project ownership. Join our team of 7 and turn big ideas into production models!




Your profile

You have a background in data science, AI, statistics, or a related field
You have at least 3 years of experience building data science or machine learning solutions
You are comfortable working in Python
You have experience with modern data/ML tooling (e.g. Docker, Databricks, MLflow, or similar MLOps platforms)
You are interested in media, video, or multimodal content (text, images, video)
You are curious and enjoy exploring new ideas
You enjoy working with others, but are also comfortable working independently
You like taking ownership and driving your own projects
You like working directly with stakeholders and understanding their needs
You enjoy helping others and contributing to a positive team culture
You are comfortable speaking up, sharing your ideas, and staying open to input from others
You are based in the Netherlands and allowed to work here




Your tasks

Work on a wide range of problems across the company (e.g. subtitles, forecasting, marketing mix, thumbnails, churn)
Identify and prioritize opportunities for data science, shape them into projects, and drive them forward with stakeholders
Work with stakeholders to understand problems and turn them into data science solutions
Analyze data, build models, create prototypes, experiment with new approaches
Put models into production and keep them running over time
Take ownership of projects from idea to real impact
Work closely with teammates (typically in pairs), support interns, and collaborate with researchers
Bring energy to the team and those around us: share ideas, help others, and contribute to a positive team environment




Your team

We are a team of 7 data scientists and a data science manager, looking for one more colleague.

We build data products that have a direct impact on our consumers, advertisers, and employees. We work on a wide range of problems. One day, you might build a model to select the most appealing thumbnail for Videoland. Another day, you might help decide what movie to show on RTL 7. The next, you might be fixing a production issue in our search system. No day is the same.

The Data Science team is part of the Data Unit, where we work closely with data engineers, analysts, and other specialists.

Our tech stack is centered around Python (Pandas, PyTorch, Transformers) and Azure. We work with tools like PySpark, Airflow, MLflow, and Databricks, and deploy our solutions using Docker and Kubernetes. Most of our data comes from Snowflake and Azure Event Hub.




The interview process

Our interview process is designed to give you a good sense of the team, the work, and how we collaborate. It also helps us understand how you think and approach problems.




This is what a typical process looks like (we may adapt it along the way if needed):

Intro call (1h): get to know each other and learn more about the team

Experience interview (1h): discuss your past work and how you approach problems

Technical exercise (1h): work on a real data science problem and walk us through your thinking

We’re mainly interested in how you think, communicate, and collaborate — not in perfect answers. You should also use these conversations to decide if this is a team you’d enjoy working in.




We look forward to receiving your application via our website.

Title: Medior Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
Join Allianz Direct!

The machine learning engineering chapter at Allianz Direct is a global team consisting of experienced data scientists / machine learning engineers that have been pioneering new use cases in insurance and building a modern machine learning platform. The team is responsible for the development, deployment, and maintenance of machine learning models in all 5 countries where Allianz Direct is currently active. We are looking for a medior data scientist / ML engineer to grow the team in Rotterdam, to build and deploy machine learning solutions end-to-end to serve business needs.

You Will Get To


Work with experienced data scientists / ML engineers and focus on building one or two machine learning solutions at a time. Develop your models end-to-end, from ideation with business stakeholders to deployment and monitoring.
Dive into a range of challenging modelling problems around our pricing engine, claim processes, customer contact center and operations. You can expect to tackle problems using classification, regression, anomaly detection, survival modelling, time series and large language models.
Utilize our mature next generation data platform hosted on Databricks, containing well organized data across all Allianz Direct countries.
Help to extend our machine learning platform used for development and deployment of a range of models, in both batch and API inference modes.
Collaborate with dev engineers to embed a deployed model into company processes.
Contribute to our continuously evolving way of working and internal packages, as well as benefit from and contribute to our weekly knowledge sharing sessions.
Work on a modern tech stack. We use Python, Databricks, AzureML, MLflow and can leverage shared compute for large training jobs.
Work together with diverse international colleagues based in Spain, Netherlands, Germany, Italy, and France.


Your Profile


Located in the Netherlands, since this hybrid role requires working with the team at the office location in Rotterdam.
Academic degree (MSc or PhD), preferably in a relevant technical field such as computer science, data science, physics, econometrics, or engineering.
A strong foundation in machine learning fundamentals. You know how to properly apply a wide range of algorithms for classification, regression, and other predictive problems.
At least 5 years of experience in a similar data science or ML engineering role.
A love for coding. Programming experience in Python is required and you are familiar with libraries like pandas/scikit-learn, and have experience doing hyper parameter tuning for a diverse set of models including boosting models.
Experience with MLOps on Databricks or experience within the insurance business are a strong plus.
You are a self-learner. You are eager to keep developing and improving, and stay on top of the latest developments. You enjoy both sharing knowledge and learning from others.
Fluent in English. Able to communicate complex topics in a clear and precise manner to audiences with different backgrounds and at different levels.


What We Offer

At Allianz Direct you will find yourself in an inspiring working environment where there is plenty of room to set up your own initiatives, in an international scope. We believe that success starts with satisfied employees. That's why we offer you:


An attractive monthly salary based on knowledge and experience, starting at €5200.00 (based on full-time employment of 38 hours).
A bonus of 12.5% of your gross annual salary and 8% holiday allowance.
An NS business card which you can also use privately, or a travel allowance (€0.23/km).
Flexible working: 60/40 home/office, for which you will receive a home working allowance of up to €40.00 per month.
Vacation days: 25 for full-time employment. You can get up to 38 vacation days per year for 40 hours per week.
A pension plan with a small personal contribution of only 3.5%.
An annual contract with the intention of a permanent contract.
A prime office location in the heart of Rotterdam, close to shops and restaurants.
Festive moments are celebrated: an extensive end-of-year drinks party and a fun summer party.
Discount on Allianz Direct insurance products.

Title: Data Scientist II - Finance Payments
Description:
Job Title: Data Scientist II - Finance Payments

Team Location: Amsterdam, the Netherlands

About Us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

About the team:

The successful candidate will join the Data Science & Analytics team within the Finance Payments Accounting organization.In this role, the Data Scientist II will own and deliver end-to-end data science solutions supporting Payments and Accounting. They will partner closely with business and technical stakeholders to translate complex finance and accounting problems into analytical and modelling approaches, delivering actionable insights and data-driven solutions.The role will involve applying statistical and predictive analytics, as well as emerging GenAI techniques, to address business problems across Payments and Accounting. The Data Scientist II will also explore and apply GenAI capabilities to enhance the analysis and interpretation of Accounting data and develop intelligent, scalable solutions that improve decision-making and business processes.

Role Description:

Data Scientist II takes full ownership of the design and delivery of data science solutions, from ideation to implementation. They work independently on tasks like data consumption, preparation, and the translation of business problems into data stories. This role involves applying suitable statistical data analysis and modeling methods to solve complex business problems. Data Scientist II works within the scope of their team, and occasionally across partner teams, to inform business decisions. They independently identify and manage stakeholders, effectively communicating complex analysis results. As experienced members of the team, they provide guidance to junior colleagues, act as force multipliers, and contribute significantly to their community. They stay updated about the larger data ecosystem and the goals of their track and business unit, ensuring the quality of their work through peer review. They play a key role in influencing business decisions within their specific area.

Key Job Responsibilities:


Own the design and delivery of end-to-end Data Science and Analytics solutions for Finance, Payments and Accounting, from ideation through implementation.
Partner closely with business stakeholders, product and data platform teams to understand complex Accounting and Finance problems, translate them into data-driven solutions, and deliver measurable business value.
Lead the identification, development and implementation of GenAI solutions and intelligent agents to enhance Accounting processes, analytics, insights and decision-making.
Apply statistical, predictive and other Data Science and Analytics techniques to solve complex business problems and generate actionable insights.
Identify opportunities to leverage GenAI to elevate existing Data Science and Analytics capabilities, improve efficiency, and enable new ways of working within the Accounting function.
Work collaboratively with business, Data Science and Data Engineering stakeholders to ensure solutions are scalable, reliable and fit for production.
Responsible for designing and interpreting quantitative experiments, where appropriate, to objectively guide business decision-making.
Communicate complex analytical and GenAI concepts and outcomes clearly to business stakeholders and influence decision-making.
Act as a force multiplier for the team by sharing Data Science, Analytics and GenAI expertise and supporting the development of junior colleagues.



Role Qualifications and Requirements:


Experience applying GenAI methods and building production-scale agents to develop intelligent analytics and data-driven solutions for complex business problems; domain experience in finance or fintech is preferred.
Proven experience applying Data Science to complex business problems and delivering measurable outcomes.
Strong knowledge of experimental design, A/B testing, statistical inference and quantitative decision-making.
Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python or R, with experience preparing and modelling large datasets.
Familiarity with modern data platforms and workflows such as Snowflake, Spark, dbt, ETL and data-quality practices.
Strong stakeholder management, data visualization and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate insights and influence business decisions.
Experience in Finance, Fintech or Payments is desirable.



Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:


Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave
Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)
Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit



Inclusion at Booking.com:

Inclusion has been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.

Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.”

We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Application Process:


Let’s go places together: How we Hire
Detailed instructions on post-application requirements including any required application materials, deadlines, portfolios, coding challenges, or other assessments as defined by BU or department.



Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive

Title: Senior Data Scientist (Data, Pricing & Yield)
Description:
For this position you need to speak and write Dutch fluently.




Ben jij een ervaren Data Scientist die energie krijgt van complexe datasets, voorspellende modellen en commerciële optimalisatie? Wil jij met data miljoenen online transacties beïnvloeden en direct impact maken op omzet, conversie en klantgedrag? Dan is dit jouw kans.




House of Tickets – het bedrijf achter VakantieVeilingen, Tripper, VavaBid en Blue Tickets – zoekt een Senior Data Scientist die onze commerciële algoritmes, pricingmodellen en data intelligence verder ontwikkelt. Jij vertaalt onze data naar slimme modellen die onze platformen nóg slimmer, persoonlijker en winstgevender maken.




Jouw rol

Als Senior Data Scientist ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van voorspellende modellen, pricingstrategieën en algoritmes die onze e-commerce platformen optimaal laten presteren.




Je werkt op het snijvlak van Data Science, Machine Learning, Pricing en E-commerce en bent een belangrijke sparringpartner voor het Management Team en onze CEO. Wat ga je verder doen:

Ontwikkelen van voorspellende modellen voor pricing, yield en conversie.
Ontwerpen van algoritmes voor prijsoptimalisatie en dynamische pricing.
Ontwikkelen van forecastingmodellen voor vraag, omzet en klantgedrag.
Toepassen van Machine Learning om commerciële processen verder te automatiseren.
Analyseren van miljoenen transacties, biedingen en gebruikersinteracties.
Ontwikkelen van segmentatie-, recommendation- en personalisatiemodellen.
Opzetten en analyseren van A/B-testen en experimenten.
Signaleren van patronen en commerciële kansen binnen grote datasets.
Verbeteren van datakwaliteit, feature engineering en modelperformance.




Jij zorgt ervoor dat data niet alleen inzicht geeft, maar daadwerkelijk onze platformen slimmer maakt




Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij House of Tickets betekent werken in een organisatie waar data écht centraal staat. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om nieuwe technieken te introduceren en hebt directe invloed op miljoenen transacties en bezoekers. Daarnaast bieden wij:

Een uitstekend salaris passend bij jouw ervaring.
Bonusregeling.
28 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur).
Pensioenregeling waarvan wij 75% van de premie betalen.
Laptop en alle tools die je nodig hebt.
Volop ruimte om te experimenteren met AI en Machine Learning.
Moderne werkplek in Leiderdorp met gratis parkeren.
Dagelijks verse lunch.
Informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en veel ondernemerschap.




Wie ben jij?

Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt als een Data Scientist. Je houdt ervan om complexe vraagstukken op te lossen en weet theorie om te zetten in praktische toepassingen die direct impact hebben op omzet, conversie en gebruikerservaring.

Je bent niet iemand die alleen dashboards bouwt, maar iemand die modellen ontwikkelt waarmee de business dagelijks betere beslissingen neemt. Wat breng jij verder mee:

WO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Econometrie, Wiskunde of Computer Science.
Minimaal 8 jaar ervaring als Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer of vergelijkbare functie.
Ervaring e-commerce, pricing, marketplaces of online platformen.
Uitstekende programmeervaardigheden in Python.
Ervaring met SQL en grote datasets, Looker en GA4
Ervaring met BigQuery of vergelijkbare cloud datawarehouses
Kennis van statistiek, regressiemodellen, clustering, classificatie en forecasting
Ervaring met experimentdesign en A/B-testen.




Over House of Tickets

House of Tickets is de organisatie achter de succesvolle e-commerceplatformen VakantieVeilingen, Tripper, VavaBid en Blue Tickets. Dagelijks verwerken we duizenden transacties en miljoenen gebruikersinteracties.




Met data, technologie en slimme algoritmes bouwen we continu aan een betere gebruikerservaring, hogere conversies en maximale waarde voor onze klanten én partners.




Al sinds 2017 zijn we dé online bestemming voor deals op het gebied van dagjes uit, avondjes weg en overnachtingen – altijd met hoge kortingen. Met meer dan 90 collega’s en meer dan 10.000 transacties per dag verbinden we dagelijks consumenten met onvergetelijke ervaringen van meer dan 1.000 partners.




Naast onze consumentenplatformen organiseren we zelf evenementen zoals World of Dino’s en bieden we via Blue Tickets white label ticket oplossingen voor partners.




Onze missie: Wij helpen mensen méér uit hun vrije tijd te halen. Met inspirerende, betaalbare deals waar iedereen plezier van heeft.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Buyer
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

The Buyer Domain at Vinted is dedicated to creating a seamless, delightful, and highly engaging experience for our members as they search, discover, and purchase items. Our challenge is unique: unlike standard e-commerce, our peer-to-peer catalog consists of hundreds of millions of entirely unique, single-inventory listings, with millions of new items uploaded daily. Connecting the right buyer with the perfect item in real-time is at the very core of Vinted's success.

To tackle this challenge at scale, we are looking to bring talented Data Scientists into the Buyer Domain's two highly specialized, ML-focused teams:


Search Relevance: This team is responsible for the retrieval and ranking systems that power search queries across all markets. Their mission is to ensure our members can effortlessly find exactly what they are looking for in Vinted's vast, unique catalog. The team's ownership and focus areas include multi-stage search ranking pipelines, query intent classification, semantic dense retrieval, and the integration of ML relevance models with content policy controls, all optimized for real-time execution.
Recommender Relevance: This team owns the Recommender System that powers Vinted’s Homepage Feed and which is responsible for driving a significant portion of all discoveries and purchases across the platform. Their mission is to inspire our members by surfacing highly personalized, engaging, and relevant recommendations. The team's ownership and focus areas include deep sequence-based user modeling, real-time candidate generation and ranking, and exploration of diverse member interests, built to handle massive scale and high-throughput constraints.


We will work with you to match your background, technical interests, and experience with the team where you can drive the most impact. Regardless of the team you join, you will be a proactive product partner. We work in a highly collaborative culture to align on technical approaches, and we validate all changes through rigorous offline evaluation and online A/B testing on our custom-built, in-house Experimentation platform.

In this position, you’ll


Build and optimize end-to-end machine learning models for retrieval, ranking, and personalization (e.g. gradient boosting, two-tower architectures, sequence models, and neural rerankers).
Partner closely with platform and software engineers to serve models directly in our search and recommendation engines, optimizing for high throughput and millisecond-level latency budgets.
Lead or contribute to collaborative design proposals for new modeling approaches, features, or training pipelines.
Define tracking requirements, perform offline evaluations, and design and analyze online A/B tests to measure real-world business impact.
Collaborate with Data, Engineering and Product stakeholders to identify product opportunities, translate business problems into ML objectives, and align on technical trade-offs.
Share knowledge, participate in peer reviews, and actively contribute to the growth and development of other scientists in the ML Guild and the Data Science & Analytics function.


About You

We are looking for Data Scientists who strike a balance between deep technical curiosity and practical business impact, engineers who are passionate about making second-hand fashion highly discoverable.


A strong collaborator with hands-on experience designing, training, and deploying machine learning models in a production environment (ideally within search, recommendations, or large-scale personalization).
High proficiency in Python and SQL. Experience with deep learning frameworks and gradient boosting libraries.
Solid understanding of modern information retrieval, Learning-to-Rank (LTR), semantic search, or sequence-based user preference modeling.
Experience or strong interest in high-performance model serving. Familiarity with search/vector engines like Vespa or Elasticsearch, and serving frameworks like Triton, is a plus.
Comfort working with massive datasets in modern cloud-based data warehouses.
Strong grasp of statistics, offline evaluation metrics, and online A/B testing methodologies.


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
25 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Frequent team-building events
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per working day
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€67.700—€91.500 EUR

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In two years' time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over one million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.

About The Opportunity

We are an exchange. The speed of good decisions matter in everything that we do. Our data domain is committed to making sure the decisions this business makes on spend, pricing, product, risk and financial crime rest on evidence rather than intuition. We're seeking exceptional talent to join us in making this a reality.

The Problems You'll Get to Solve


Growth & causal inference. Measure true incrementality, own our marketing mix model, and turn that into spend allocation under a budget.
Product & personalization. Rank and surface what is relevant to each customer's behaviour and holdings, from asset discovery to order form defaults, without drowning users in noise
Markets, pricing & execution. Model fee and spread elasticity to find the revenue-versus-volume trade-off, and improve execution quality: slippage, order routing, liquidity provider selection.
Risk & financial integrity. Model risk exposure across a volatile asset book, forecast liquidation risk, and detect reconciliation breaks across internal ledgers, on-chain data and partner reporting.
Financial crime & compliance. Detect account takeover, payment fraud and mule networks in real time, combining business rules and models that work together while staying explainable and auditable.


What You'll Be Doing


Own problems end to end: frame the question with the stakeholder, build the model or experiment, ship it, and follow it into production.
Work backwards from the decision. Start from what someone needs to decide and what it costs to get it wrong, not from the data that happens to be available.
Stay accountable for your models once they are live: monitoring, drift, retraining, and the day they start behaving differently.
Tell senior stakeholders things they do not want to hear, including that a campaign, a feature or a rule did not work.
Support your teammates in growing every day by setting the standard for how we do causal inference, reviewing their work, and sharing knowledge.


What We Look For


Strong applied experience turning a messy business question into a model or a measurement: causal inference where that fits, predictive and ranking models where it does not. You know when a result is not real.
Fluency in Python and SQL, and comfort working independently rather than waiting for data to be handed to you. We use Snowflake, dbt, Airflow and Looker, on top of technologies like MySQL, Druid, Kafka and Flink.
A track record of models that made it into production and changed a decision, not just notebooks and slide decks.
Sound statistical judgement, and the honesty to quantify and communicate uncertainty rather than hide it.
Exceptional communication skills. We expect you to talk to various stakeholders to derive requirements, drive discussions, and facilitate decision-making processes effectively.
Extraordinary sense of ownership. We are committed to empowering people with freedom and accountability.


Nice To Have


Experience building with agentic tooling such as MCP or agent frameworks, or automation platforms like n8n.


At Bitvavo, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, foster creativity, and lead to better outcomes. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, or any other characteristic. Join us and be part of a team that values and celebrates your unique contributions.

Bitvavo does not accept resumes from staffing, search, or recruitment firms without a signed agreement. If you send us a resume without such an agreement, we may contact the candidate directly without any obligation whatsoever and no fee of any kind will be paid should we hire the candidate.

What We Offer

At Bitvavo, we believe in attracting, motivating and retaining talented people through market-competitive offerings that go beyond compensation alone. To learn more about our total rewards package and the benefits we offer, visit our Life at Bitvavo page.
