Title: Promotion – State of Health (SoH) von Elektronik
Description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung

Bei Bosch gestalten wir Zukunft mit hochwertigen Technologien und Dienstleistungen, die Begeisterung wecken und das Leben der Menschen verbessern. Unser Versprechen an unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter steht dabei felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und inspirieren uns gegenseitig. Willkommen bei Bosch.

Die Robert Bosch GmbH freut sich auf deine Bewerbung!

Stellenbeschreibung


Du entwickelst ein KI‑basiertes SoH‑Konzept, das die verbleibende Nutzungsdauer von Elektronik präzise abschätzt und als Grundlage für nachhaltige Produktentscheidungen dient.
Eine Produktentscheidungsmatrix unter Berücksichtigung von Kriterien wie Wirtschaftlichkeit und Design erarbeitest du und führst diese zur Anwendungsreife.
Das entwickelte SoH‑Konzept bewertest du umfassend, indem du geeignete Methoden wie die hybride Modellierung einsetzt und deren Wirksamkeit nachweist.
Darüber hinaus wendest du deine Erkenntnisse auf ein Fokusprodukt an und integrierst Inspektionsdaten aus der Produktion (SPI, AOI, AXI), 0‑km‑Ausfalldaten, Zuverlässigkeitsdaten sowie Feldbelastungen.
Du analysierst und bewertest selbstständig Grundlagen sowie Methoden und führst gezielte Tests zur Identifikation und Auswertung von Fehlerbildern durch.
Im engen Austausch mit dem AVT‑Team, deinen Betreuenden bei CR/APT3 sowie der kooperierenden Universität förderst du den Wissenstransfer und die interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit.
Auf Basis deiner Forschungsergebnisse veröffentlichst du in referierten Fachjournalen und präsentierst deine Ergebnisse auf internationalen Tagungen, um den wissenschaftlichen Diskurs aktiv mitzugestalten.


Qualifikationen


Ausbildung: sehr guter Masterabschluss in Mikrosystemtechnik, Mikroelektronik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
Erfahrungen und Know-how:
praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich der datenbasierten Modellierung (z. B. hybride Modellierung, vorausschauende Wartung / Predictive Maintenance, Anomalieerkennung)
Programmierkenntnisse in Python und relevanten Bibliotheken (z. B. PyTorch)
Expertise im Bereich der Zuverlässigkeit (Lebensdauer, Ausfallmechanismen, Prüfung / Testing) von Elektronik
Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: du zeichnest dich durch ein starkes Interesse an technischer Nachhaltigkeit aus, insbesondere an der Verlängerung der Produktlebensdauer und der Schonung von Ressourcen; zudem bringst du ausgeprägte analytische und kommunikative Fähigkeiten mit; deine hohe wissenschaftliche Neugier treibt dich an, komplexe technische Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen und innovative Lösungsansätze zu entwickeln
Begeisterung: du begeisterst dich für Nachhaltigkeit und datenbasierte Modellierung
Sprachen: sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Sie denken in Zusammenhängen und möchten mit Daten echte Mehrwerte schaffen? Dann erwartet Sie bei uns eine spannende Aufgabe. In dieser Position analysieren Sie Unternehmens- und Produktionsdaten, leiten daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ab und tragen aktiv zur Optimierung unserer Prozesse bei.




Ihre Aufgaben bei uns

Die Analyse, Aufbereitung und Interpretation großer Datenmengen aus Produktions- und Unternehmensprozessen gehören zu Ihren Haupttätigkeiten.
Auf dieser Basis entwickeln und implementieren Sie Kennzahlen (KPIs), die eine gezielte Steuerung und Optimierung interner Abläufe ermöglichen.
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachabteilungen wie Produktion, Logistik und Controlling identifizieren Sie Optimierungspotenziale entlang der Supply Chain.
Sie erstellen aussagekräftige Reports, Dashboards und Entscheidungsgrundlagen für das Management.
Darüber hinaus unterstützen Sie bei der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung von IT-Systemen sowie Datenarchitekturen.
Ad-hoc-Analysen führen Sie eigenständig durch und präsentieren die Ergebnisse.

Ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Daten sowie ein gutes Verständnis für deren Zusammenhänge zeichnen Sie aus.
Im Umgang mit Datenanalyse-Tools wie Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Microsoft SQL Reporting Services, Python oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen arbeiten Sie sicher.
Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Erfahrung im Supply Chain Management sowie im Umgang mit unternehmensinternen Kennzahlensystemen.
Analytisches Denkvermögen, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative zeichnen Sie aus.

Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Ihr Profil ab.

Freuen Sie sich auf eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen sowie kurze Entscheidungswege.
Gleitzeit und mindestens ein Tag Homeoffice pro Woche sorgen für mehr Flexibilität im Arbeitsalltag.

Sie denken in Zusammenhängen und möchten mit Daten echte Mehrwerte schaffen? Dann erwartet Sie bei uns eine spannende Aufgabe. In dieser Position analysieren Sie Unternehmens- und Produktionsdaten, leiten daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ab und tragen aktiv zur Optimierung unserer Prozesse bei.


Ihre Aufgaben bei uns

  • Die Analyse, Aufbereitung und Interpretation großer Datenmengen aus Produktions- und Unternehmensprozessen gehören zu Ihren Haupttätigkeiten.
  • Auf dieser Basis entwickeln und implementieren Sie Kennzahlen (KPIs), die eine gezielte Steuerung und Optimierung interner Abläufe ermöglichen.
  • In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachabteilungen wie Produktion, Logistik und Controlling identifizieren Sie Optimierungspotenziale entlang der Supply Chain.
  • Sie erstellen aussagekräftige Reports, Dashboards und Entscheidungsgrundlagen für das Management.
  • Darüber hinaus unterstützen Sie bei der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung von IT-Systemen sowie Datenarchitekturen.
  • Ad-hoc-Analysen führen Sie eigenständig durch und präsentieren die Ergebnisse.


Das bringen Sie mit

  • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation oder haben berufliche Erfahrung in den genannten Umfeldern.
  • Ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Daten sowie ein gutes Verständnis für deren Zusammenhänge zeichnen Sie aus.
  • Im Umgang mit Datenanalyse-Tools wie Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Microsoft SQL Reporting Services, Python oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen arbeiten Sie sicher.
  • Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Erfahrung im Supply Chain Management sowie im Umgang mit unternehmensinternen Kennzahlensystemen.
  • Analytisches Denkvermögen, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative zeichnen Sie aus.
  • Sie sind in der Lage, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich aufzubereiten und zielgruppengerecht zu vermitteln.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Ihr Profil ab.


Das bieten wir Ihnen

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit hoher Relevanz für unternehmerische Entscheidungen.
  • Sie erwartet ein attraktives Gehalt, 30 Tage Urlaub, Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld, Einkaufsvorteile sowie eine Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg.
  • Neben einer kostenlosen Gruppenunfallversicherung profitieren Sie von einer vorteilhaften betrieblichen Altersversorgung.
  • Freuen Sie sich auf eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen sowie kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Gleitzeit und mindestens ein Tag Homeoffice pro Woche sorgen für mehr Flexibilität im Arbeitsalltag.
  • Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung unterstützt Sie beim Einstieg in Ihre neue Rolle.
  • Für Ihre Gesundheit bieten wir Ihnen betriebsärztliche Versorgung, gemeinsame Sportevents sowie attraktive JobRad-Leasingmodelle.
  • Alle unsere Benefits finden Sie im Vorteilsprogramm Wevo.


Klingt das nach Ihrer nächsten Herausforderung?

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Onlinebewerbung! Bei Fragen wenden Sie sich gerne an Melanie Krakowski aus unserem Bereich Human Resources, Telefon: +49 711 167 61-592.

Title: Senior AI & GenAI Architect (w/m/x)
Description:
Wir sind Teil von NTT DATA, einem führenden Anbieter von Unternehmens- und Technologiedienstleistungen, KI und digitaler Infrastruktur mit einem Umsatz von über 30 Mrd. $. Als Global Top Employer betreut NTT DATA 75 % der Fortune Global 100-Unternehmen und entwickelt mit Expert:innen in über 70 Ländern gemeinsam innovative Lösungen, die dazu inspirieren, Neues zu wagen und Erfolge sichtbar zu machen. In der DACH-Region sind wir an 15 Standorten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz vertreten.

Make this the place where you grow

NTT DATA liefert in der DACH Region (Deutschland, Österreich, Schweiz) einen wesentlichen Wertbeitrag zum Unternehmenserfolg, in dem sie mittels ihrer horizontalen Portfolios und Services die IT-technologischen Anforderungen in allen Industriezweigen bedient. Die Business Unit "AI Delivery" bietet eine Funktion, mit deren Unterstützung insbesondere komplexere Anforderungen evaluiert, konzipiert und beantwortet werden können. Für dieses abwechslungsreiche Umfeld wird ein AI und GenAI Architect (w/m/x) gesucht, der innovative Lösungen entwickelt, technische Verantwortung übernimmt und Kunden strategisch berät. Du bringst umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von AI- und GenAI-Lösungen mit und arbeitest eng mit internationalen Teams zusammen, um maßgeschneiderte Strategien zu realisieren.

Deine Benefits


Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Gleitzeitregelung und Reisezeit ist Arbeitszeit
Home-Office Möglichkeit sowie Vereinbarung mit Vergütungszuschuss inkl. Arbeitsplatzausstattung möglich
30 Tage Urlaub, zusätzlich sind der 24.12. und 31.12. arbeitsfreie Tage
Sabbatical bis zu einem Jahr möglich
Remote Work sowie mobiles Arbeiten im EU-Ausland möglich
Attraktive Benefit- und Entgeltoptimierungsprogramme: betriebliche Altersvorsorge, JobRad, Jobticket, exklusive Rabatte über Corporate Benefits und vieles mehr
Umfangreiche Gesundheits- und Vorsorgeangebote: verlängerte Entgeltfortzahlung im Krankheitsfall, Betriebsärztliche Betreuung, Unfallversicherung auch für Freizeitunfälle weltweit, Familienservice
Interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten in der NTT DATA Academy mit fachlichen Trainings, Zertifizierungsangeboten, Soft-Skill-Schulungen, Udemy Zugang
Diverse Communities und Initiativen (zu Diversity, Equity & Inclusion, ESG und mehr) mit Wissensaustausch auf Augenhöhe
Teamorientierte Unternehmenskultur mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum



Deine Mission


Du entwickelst innovative AI-Lösungen und gestaltest skalierbare sowie praxisnahe Systeme, die unseren internationalen Kunden echten Mehrwert bieten.
Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für den gesamten Lebenszyklus der AI-Lösungen, von der ersten Idee über die Entwicklung bis zur finalen Umsetzung und Optimierung.
Du berätst unsere Kunden zu AI-Technologien und -anwendungen und entwickelst individuelle Lösungen, die ihren Bedürfnissen entsprechen.
Du konzipierst und designst komplexe E2E AI- und GenAI-Lösungen unter Verwendung modernster OSS- und Cloud-Native-Technologien und orchestrierst MLOps sowie LLMOps in produktiven Systemen..
Du arbeitest aktiv mit internationalen Teams zusammen, führst Workshops durch und unterstützt Kunden sowie Teammitglieder mit deinem technischen Know-how.
Du evaluierst und empfiehlst neue AI-Technologien und unterstützt bei Angeboten und Kundenworkshops, um Innovationen voranzutreiben.



Dein Skillset


Du hast einen Abschluss in Informatik, Data Science, Künstlicher Intelligenz, Mathematik oder einem verwandten Bereich; ein Master oder Ph.D. ist von Vorteil.
Du bringst mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Implementierung von AI- und Machine-Learning-Lösungen sowohl on Prem als auch in der Cloud mit.
Du hast mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von GenAI-Lösungen, wie RAG oder Agenten.
Du verfügst über nachgewiesene technische Kenntnisse in relevanten Programmiersprachen, vorzugsweise Python, und hast Erfahrung mit AI- und GenAI-Frameworks wie SciKit-Learn, PyTorch, KubeFlow, HuggingFace, LangChain oder ähnlichen Framework.
Du hast die Fähigkeit, Softwarelösungen zu entwerfen, zu entwickeln und zu erstellen, idealerweise für AI- und GenAI-Projekte, und kennst agile Softwareentwicklungsmethoden.
Du arbeitest unabhängig und kooperativ in internationalen Teams, hast verhandlungssichere Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch und bringst effizientes Zeitmanagement sowie Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit.



Mit uns hast du unzählige Möglichkeiten, groß zu denken, mutig zu handeln und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Gestalte deine Zukunft in einer Kultur, die Zugehörigkeit lebt und dir Raum für Lernen und Networking gibt.

Vielfalt ist ein unverzichtbarer Teil unseres Erfolges und unserer Unternehmenskultur. Frei von Vorurteilen im Hinblick auf Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Alter, ethnische und soziale Herkunft, Religion oder Behinderung freuen wir uns dich kennenzulernen. Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt.

Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Deine Online-Bewerbung!

Flexibilität: Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten, flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung und top ausgestattete Büros in zentraler Lage, 30 Tage Urlaub, verschiedene Sonderurlaubstage
Benefit Angebot: Bezuschussung zum Deutschlandticket, Jobfahrräder und Firmenwagen, vergünstigte Konditionen für zahlreiche Sport- und Wellnessangebote, Kooperation mit heyCare, die dich bei deiner Kinder- und Seniorenbetreuung unterstützen, Zugang zu einem umfangreichen Mitarbeitervorteilsportal (Rabattportal) u.v.m.

Sonstige administrative Aufgaben (z.B. Auftragsnachverfolgung und Rechnungsstellungsprozess)

Selbstständige Arbeitsweise verbunden mit Teamfähigkeit sowie kundenorientiertem Handeln und Denken

Title: Senior AI Engineer (m/f/d)
Company: IU International University of Applied Sciences
Description:
Join us to make education accessible for all!

Strengthen our Syntea AI team in full-time (40 hrs./week) as Senior AI Engineer (m/f/d) within Germany or UK remotely or at one of our office locations.

In this role you'll help build the AI systems behind Syntea, IU's own AI-powered learning assistant and a critical part of IU's AI-first strategy. Syntea acts as a personal AI tutor for IU's distance-learning students, now supporting more than 80,000 learners with conversational tutoring, adaptive learning, study organization, and administrative tools in a single chat-based platform. As an AI engineer, you'll help design and build the LLM- and agent-powered services that make all of this work, at scale and in production.

Your tasks


Help build and maintain the backend services and APIs that power Syntea, its domain agents, and AI-driven micro-apps.
Develop LLM-powered and agentic pipelines — prompting, retrieval (RAG), orchestration, and tool use — ensuring scalability, modularity, and reliability across the Syntea ecosystem.
Partner with Product and other engineers to turn research ideas and prototypes into robust, production-grade AI services.
Help test and evaluate AI features — from prompt and model evaluation to monitoring and continuous improvement in production.
Own data engineering for personalization: turn existing student data (study goals, usage patterns, gamification signals) into personalized, context-aware responses and proposals.


Your Profile


5 years of professional software/AI engineering experience, with solid Python skills and some experience shipping production services in a product team.
Deep, hands-on experience building production LLM/AI systems — retrieval, tool use, orchestration — ideally including multi-agent or agentic architectures. AI depth is the heart of this role.
Experience with AI evaluation and quality (offline/online eval, automated analysis of model outputs) and a rigorous, data-driven mindset.
Solid data engineering ability: modeling and pipelines that feed personalization and analytics.
Awareness of AI security and safety considerations in user-facing systems.


We offer


Be you at IU: We support and empower you to achieve your personal and professional goals. After all, your happiness significantly contributes to a positive and productive environment.
Work wherever you want...: Digitalization is part of our DNA. Decide for yourself which place sparks the most productivity in you. You love remote work? No problem! Would you like to work abroad for a while? Our WorkFlex Benefit makes it possible.
... and flexible in terms of time: It's your job; We trust you and give you the greatest possible freedom to organize yourself.
Take your knowledge to a new level: Where else, if not with us? Enjoy free access to all our e-learning platforms. In addition, we will finance you a complete technology course of your choic
Make your journey sustainable: Whether it's a DeutschlandTicket subsidised to just €13.45, or a Jobrad (bike leasing) offer, enjoy the freedom of mobility for both work and personal activities, while also making an eco-friendly choice.
33 days to rest: Taking breaks is important! In addition to 30 flexible vacation days per year, we also give you additional days off on your birthday, Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve.


IU International University of Applied Science (IU) is Germany's largest university of applied science - and we are not just an excellent choice for studying, but also an outstanding Great Place to Work®! As an Edutech company, we rely on state-of-the-art technology and data-driven approaches. That's why AI-driven voice assistants and other GPT systems have long become part of our daily work routine, helping us to focus on exciting projects. Here at IU over 4,000 employees are dedicated to making a difference.

Become part of our Engineering team! We're passionate, competitive, open to all things new - and we love data. We live to code anything that makes IU students and IU services better.

Sounds like the perfect job for you? Then apply now! Simple, fast and even without a cover letter. If you have any further questions, please feel free to contact Ronja at ronja.kaiser@iu.org.

Please note that, for data protection reasons, we are not allowed to process email applications.

Actions speak louder than words: We cherish our "Culture of Everyone" and would like to take this opportunity to empathize that we do not tolerate discrimination towards any race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation or disability. We welcome you as you are and look forward to nurturing our diverse community at the IU!

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Northmill Bank is a challenger bank at the intersection of technology and finance, committed to revolutionizing the way people manage and protect their financial well-being. We are creating a different kind of banking experience, digital yet personal.

Northmill Bank was founded in 2006 and have grown to over 240 employees in 3 countries and over 270 000 customers. We use the latest technology to develop safe, smart, and user-friendly products for our customers. They are the sole reason why we do what we do. We are a 100% cloud-based product company where technology is the driver to create smarter banking products.

Grab this opportunity to be a part of us and our journey!

About Our Tech Stack



Dagster
Snowflake
DBT
Amazon Quick
AWS (Lambda, S3, ECR)



About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our dynamic and cross-functional team. As a Senior Data Scientist at Northmill, you will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, fellow Data Scientists, Analysts, and key business stakeholders to proactively identify opportunities and leverage data-driven insights that will drive our business forward. Your primary focus will be on leading data science initiatives across various areas of the bank.

In this holistic role, you will be a part of the entire model lifecycle, from data collection and preparation to implementation. You will work closely with Data Engineers to ensure the availability of high-quality data, as well as with Analysts and business leaders to ensure that your models are effectively applied and communicated across the business. Your contributions will play a vital role in shaping the future of our fintech bank, and your work will have a direct impact on our success.

Responsibilities



Take proactive ownership of the entire model lifecycle, from data collection, through modeling and analysis, to model deployment and implementation.
Work closely with Data Engineers to acquire and transform data.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and advise stakeholders to proactively anticipate business needs and translate them into data science solutions.
Create and present actionable insights and data visualizations that drive decision-making processes across the bank.
Continuously monitor and optimize models to proactively drive model refinement and communicate performance findings to stakeholders.
Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and emerging technologies in data science, proactively proposing new initiatives where applicable.



Qualifications

The ideal fit should have experience in statistical modeling and machine learning, from the financial sector, combined with strong problem-solving skills, analytical abilities, excellent stakeholder communication, and a prestigeless, collaborative spirit. We value individuals who are passionate about utilizing data to solve practical challenges and drive business outcomes.



Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field. (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics)
+5 years of experience in data science or related roles.
Proficiency in SQL/Snowflake for data querying and manipulation.
Strong programming skills in Python for data analysis and machine learning, including hands-on experience using common ML libraries.
Proficiency with Git and version control in collaborative settings.



What We Offer



A fantastic office in a prime Stockholm location with great spaces and views
An independent role with the opportunity to make a real impact
Great opportunities for professional development
Health - 5 000 kr wellness allowance
Conference abroad every other year
Breakfast and fruits every day, as well as "holy fika” each Friday
Regular after work and celebrated successes at the office

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist
We're partnering with an established fintech that's using data science to solve complex business problems at scale. Operating in a highly digital environment, data sits at the centre of decision-making, giving the team the opportunity to test ideas quickly, measure outcomes, and create meaningful impact across the business.
As the company continues to invest in its Data & ML capabilities, they're looking for a Data Scientist to join a collaborative team where curiosity, analytical thinking and commercial impact are valued just as highly as technical expertise.
About the role:This is an opportunity to apply statistics, machine learning and advanced analytics to solve real business problems. You'll work closely with commercial teams to understand complex challenges, identify opportunities, and develop data-driven solutions that create measurable value.
The role has a particular focus on marketing and growth, but you'll be joining a wider Data Science function and working alongside experienced Data Scientists on a variety of business-critical initiatives.
This is a role for someone who enjoys asking the right questions, applying the appropriate analytical techniques, and taking ownership of problems from initial exploration through to models being deployed into production and delivering measurable impact.
What you'll do:Frame business challenges as data science problems and identify the most appropriate analytical approach.Develop statistical and machine learning models that improve decision making and business performance.Design and evaluate experiments, causal analyses and predictive models to generate actionable insights.Work closely with business stakeholders to understand priorities and translate data into commercial value.Partner with engineering teams to ensure models are successfully deployed, monitored and continue delivering value in production.Identify new opportunities where data science can improve efficiency and support business growth.
About you:We're looking for someone with a strong academic foundation who enjoys applying theory to real-world business challenges.
You'll likely have:3+ years' experience in a Data Science or advanced analytics role.A degree in Mathematics, Statistics or another highly quantitative discipline, with a Master's degree or above preferred.Strong Python skills for data analysis, statistical modelling and machine learning.Excellent understanding of statistical methods, modelling techniques and when to apply them appropriately.Experience building models that have been deployed into production and created measurable business value.Confidence translating ambiguous business questions into structured analytical solutions.Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.A proactive mindset and the ability to take ownership from problem definition through to business impact.
Experience working with marketing analytics, experimentation, attribution or customer behaviour would be beneficial, but the strongest candidates will be those with excellent data science fundamentals and a passion for solving business problems.
Why join?This is a business where data genuinely drives decisions. With a highly digital product and rich datasets, you'll be able to form hypotheses, test them quickly and see the impact of your work in real time.
You'll be joining a collaborative Data & ML team within an established fintech that combines the stability of a successful business with the agility and autonomy of a smaller organisation. Rather than working on isolated research projects or predefined tickets, you'll have the opportunity to shape solutions, influence decision-making and see your work translate into measurable commercial outcomes.
The company offers a flexible hybrid working model (typically two to three days a week in their central Stockholm office), modern tooling, excellent benefits and the opportunity to work alongside experienced Data Scientists in an environment that values continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.
If you're a Data Scientist who enjoys combining strong statistical thinking with practical problem solving - and wants to see your work make a tangible business impact - we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
⚡️ What We Do

Flower is Flexible Power. We are a next-gen energy company leveraging AI and machine learning to make renewable energy stable and always available – even when the sun isn’t shining and the wind isn’t blowing.

Through smart optimization and trading of energy assets like wind and solar farms, battery systems, and EV chargers, we make renewable energy reliable and predictable, leading the charge towards the energy system of tomorrow.

🌟Who We Are

Tech company at heart. Purpose-driven at core. Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world.

At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish.

To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for a passionate and skilled Senior Data Scientist to join us!

👩‍💻 About The Role

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will shape the foundation of Flower’s short-term forecasting capabilities - powering the models that directly drive our daily trading decisions. You will be part of a small, highly skilled team operating at the intersection of data science, energy systems, and close-to-real-time market dynamics.

You will own the full lifecycle of your models - from idea to production - working closely with Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and Energy Market Experts to ensure our forecasting stack runs smoothly and is continuously improving. This is a hands-on role focussed on time-series modelling, rapid experimentation, and the ability to translate data into high-impact operational decisions.

What You’ll Do


Build & maintain short term operational forecasting models for energy volumes & prices that drive our trading decisions on a day-to-day basis
Build time series models to understand and explain recurring patterns across different measurements, products and regions to distill signals as features for your next model
Prototype quickly: iterate on simple models, validate rigorously, and scale what works in a dynamic market environment
Own the full model lifecycle: EDA, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment and continuous evaluation, supported by our team of DEs, MLEs & Energy Market Experts
Write your models in Python, version your code in Git, use CI/CD to ensure full reproducibility
Partner with DEs to evaluate and integrate new data sources (weather, grid conditions, market signals)
Collaborate & mentor across other data scientists, quants and engineers


Who You Are


Master’s or PhD in Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Engineering Physics, or a related quantitative field
5+ years building and deploying time-series prediction models in production using machine learning or classical methods
Strong command of Python and no stranger to the command line; comfortable writing clean, maintainable, production-ready code
Deep understanding of time-series forecasting and real-world modeling challenges
Prior experience in energy markets or power systems
Strong mentorship and coaching skills
Highly driven by our mission and your impact, yet humble enough to know we are all always learning
Eagerness to apply yourself in a mostly automated trading floor environment
Thrive in a fast-moving environment and adapt models as markets evolve


📍 Location

Our beautiful office is located in the heart of Södermalm, just a short walk from Slussen subway station. We encourage in-office collaboration but support a hybrid work model.

✉️ Apply

Our corporate language is English, as we have over 30 nationalities in the office. We therefore appreciate it if you could submit your CV in English.

Throughout the recruitment process you will meet with the Talent Partner, Head of Predictions and Optimization, the Team, VP of Engineering and VP of Product.

We look forward to hearing from you!

We kindly but firmly decline any engagement in recruitment assistance for our hiring processes. This includes partnership offers or the sale of recruitment tools.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
We're at a pivotal moment for both Tibber and the planet. When joining Tibber, you won’t just help scale a forward-thinking tech company – you’ll contribute to a real shift in how people consume electricity. With millions of smart devices connected to the Tibber platform (like electric vehicles and smart thermostats), we have one of the most unique energy trading portfolios on the market.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join us in making the energy transition happen – maybe that’s you?

Job Mission 🚀

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will help accelerate Data Science at Tibber by bridging the gap between advanced data science and robust production systems. You'll play a key role in building predictive data models that increase our metric of savings per kWh.

Read more about your future leader and team here.

What You'll Do ✅


Lead the ML platform build. Own the direction of our ML infrastructure: model registries, versioning, monitoring, drift detection and automated retraining, and take it from good to great. This is the core of the role, especially in your first year.
Ship models that move the metric. Develop and deploy forecasting, optimization and personalization models that plug straight into live products like Smart Charging and dynamic pricing.
Strengthen the impact chain. We evaluate every data science service against clear goals. You'll help us take the next step: connecting model quality all the way to realized savings per kWh, through counterfactual evaluation and decision-quality metrics.
Raise the bar with your peers. Review code, sharpen best practices and shape how a senior team works with LLM and agentic AI tools, as colleagues not students.
Own end-to-end delivery. Drive the full lifecycle from problem framing and data sourcing to production deployment and continuous improvement.


What We're Looking For⚡

You are driven by impact, enjoy fast-paced environments, and thrive when given autonomy. You've built an ML platform before and know how to go beyond models that work in a notebook to a system a team can trust.

We Believe You'll Be a Great Fit If You


Have a proven track record of developing production-grade ML platforms with drift detection, model registries and CI/CD workflows, and can point to teams that shipped faster because of what you built.
Possess deep technical skills in Python and hands-on experience with cloud ML infrastructure like Databricks MLflow, AWS SageMaker or an equivalent.
Bring deep expertise in at least one ML domain we run in production: time-series forecasting, optimization algorithms or personalization at scale.
Think in platforms, not patches: you build repeatable workflows and you know how to onboard a team of experienced peers into them.
Handle ambiguity well and communicate complex data concepts clearly to product and engineering stakeholders.
Embrace LLM and agentic AI tools as part of how modern data science gets done.
Bonus: experience with energy time-series data, smart charging or grid optimization.


💆🏻‍♀️💆🏽‍♂️The Tibber Mindset

Tibber exists to drive energy independence - away from fossil dependency. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households shift their electricity consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours - from electric vehicles to smart thermostats, all connected to the Tibber platform. We strengthen the resilience of the grid. Not in theory. In everyday life.

We win, fail, and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we're on a journey to make it central to everything we do. The further we go, the more our Tibberinos matter - and yes, that's what we call ourselves!

Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Oslo, Berlin, Amsterdam, and Førde. And we're still just getting started.

You're welcome at Tibber for who you are. We hire for what you can do and how you think - not your background or where you've been. Diverse teams build better products, and we mean that.

Title: Data Scientist

At If, our ability to understand risk and customer behavior through data, analytics, and modelling is at the core of our business and competitive advantage. By developing the most accurate models, we can offer the best pricing and product solutions to our customers. We are currently accelerating our efforts to become the leading organization in data, analytics, and pricing across the Nordic insurance market. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in that journey!

About The Role

As a Data Scientist, your primary responsibility will be to take a leading role in enhancing our risk and pricing models and production processes, directly impacting both our customers and our business. In this role, you will have the opportunity to:


Work with innovative methods in statistical modelling and machine learning.
Analyze large volumes of data and explore new data sources.
Work in our modern analytics platform with end-to-end ownership of the data science process.
Develop, implement, and monitor improvements in an efficient and iterative manner.
Strengthen Nordic collaboration within If’s Nordic analytics community and our sister company Hastings in the UK.

Title: Senior Data Scientist | Candy Crush Saga
Description:
Craft:

Data, Analytics & Strategy

Job Description:

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to work closely with product, game design, and engineering on game difficulty, progression, and economy in Candy Crush Saga. You will help ensure that our 23,000+ levels and game features combine into a balanced, engaging, and evolving player experience.

This is a role close to the game itself: your analyses, experiments, and models will directly shape gameplay decisions that reach millions of players. You will have significant ownership of your problem space and be a trusted analytical voice in product and design discussions.

Your role within the Kingdom


Analyze game difficulty, progression, and player behavior across the level catalog to identify friction, pacing issues, and opportunities
Design, monitor, and analyze A/B tests related to difficulty, features, and economy
Use data, models, and simulations to inform difficulty tuning, balance, and how features, boosters, and economy mechanics interact with player outcomes
Bring a strong analytical perspective to product and design discussions, helping shape priorities and trade-offs
Communicate insights, experiment results, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders with varying levels of data literacy
Define tracking specifications so the data needed to understand player interaction with levels and features is available and reliable, and build your own data models and dashboards where needed


Skills to create thrills

Product & Player Understanding


Strong product sense with the ability to reason about player experience, engagement, and frustration
Ability to translate design intent and game experience into measurable hypotheses and analyses


Analytics & Experimentation


Strong analytical coding skills in Python or R
Excellent SQL skills and experience working with large-scale player data
Solid understanding of A/B testing, experimental design, and statistical inference
Experience combining experimental results with observational analysis
Comfortable defining tracking requirements and building data models and dashboards to support your own analyses


Modeling & Problem Solving


Ability to systematically break down complex game systems into solvable analytical problems
Experience with simulation, optimization, or algorithmic approaches is a strong plus


Communication & Collaboration


Ability to influence decisions through clear storytelling, visualization, and data-driven reasoning
Comfortable working iteratively and cross-functionally with product managers, game designers, and engineers


Tasty bonus points


Experience with game difficulty balancing, progression systems, or virtual economies
Background in behavioral psychology, economics, or game theory
Experience in the games industry or other large-scale consumer products
Familiarity with large-scale experimentation platforms and live-operated products


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

Relevant akademisk utbildning inom statistik, ekonomi, datavetenskap, matematik eller motsvarande.
Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Erfarenhet från arbete inom bank eller andra finansiella tjänster.
Kunskap om bolånemarknaden och fastighetsmarknaden.
Erfarenhet från verktyg som Snowflake och Databricks.
Erfarenhet av språkmodeller.



Hos oss kan du uppleva:


Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.
Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället.
En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter.
En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen.

Title: Data Scientists & ML Engineers
Description:
Vårt team skapar datadrivna effektiva verksamheter - Visst vill du vara med?

Vill du arbeta med AI, Machine Learning och datadriven utveckling i projekt som gör skillnad på riktigt? På Agio får du kombinera teknik, analys och innovation i uppdrag som spänner över viktiga samhällsfunktioner.

Vi söker nu erfarna Data Scientists och ML Engineers till våra team i Stockholm och Luleå. Du väljer själv vilken ort du vill utgå ifrån.

Om rollerna

Som Data Scientist eller ML Engineer på Agio hjälper du våra kunder att ta nästa steg i sin digitala resa.

Våra kunder behöver stöd inom dessa två huvudinriktningar, och du behöver inte vara stark inom båda. En riktigt bra Data Scientist kan vara relevant för oss även utan erfarenhet som ML Engineer, och vice versa.

Data Scientist

Du använder data för att skapa konkret affärs- och verksamhetsvärde genom avancerad analys, statistik, Machine Learning och AI – för att exempelvis förutse, klassificera, optimera och skapa bättre beslutsstöd. Vi söker teknikorienterade Data Scientists som har en stark programmeringsvana. Du arbetar med:
Machine Learning-modeller för prediktion, klassificering och optimering
Prediktioner och prognoser
Att testa hypoteser och genomföra A/B-tester
Att träna, testa och utvärdera modeller
Att förklara analyser och resultat på ett begripligt sätt för verksamheten


ML Engineer

Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan Data Science och Data Engineering, med fokus på att få modeller och AI-lösningar att fungera i produktion – från experiment och PoC till skalbara produktionslösningar. Du arbetar med:
Att ta modeller framtagna av Data Scientists och göra dem produktionsklara
Att bygga lösningar för att träna, deploya och köra modeller automatiskt
Att säkerställa att modeller fungerar i produktion, med hänsyn till exempelvis latens och skalbarhet
Att övervaka modeller och följa drift, datadrift och prestanda över tid


Du blir en viktig del i att hjälpa organisationer att utnyttja digitaliseringens möjligheter, från effektivisering till helt nya arbetssätt.

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av
Minst 4 års arbete som Data Scientist, ML Engineer, dataanalytiker eller inom AI/ML-roller
Avancerad dataanalys och AI/ML-modeller – till exempel prediktion, klassificering, klustring eller produktionssättning av modeller, beroende på om din profil ligger mer åt Data Scientist eller ML Engineer
Python eller R
Versionshantering (Git)
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Beroende på vilken profil du känner dig mest hemma i väger vi även in:
Data Scientist: erfarenhet av bibliotek som scikit-learn, pandas/polars eller statsmodels, samt datavisualisering med Matplotlib, Seaborn eller BI-verktyg som Power BI
ML Engineer: erfarenhet av TensorFlow/PyTorch, containerteknik (Docker, Kubernetes) och verktyg för MLOps som MLflow


Det viktigaste för oss är inte en checklista av verktyg, utan att du faktiskt har arbetat med avancerad analys och modeller, eller med att sätta modeller och AI-lösningar i produktion.

Meriterande om du även har
Kunskap om informationssäkerhet, GDPR och etisk AI
Erfarenhet av Azure, AWS eller andra molntjänster, exempelvis Azure ML, SageMaker eller Databricks
API-integrationer och arbete med data från flera olika källor
Vana av RAG-lösningar, agenter och ramverk som LangChain, LangGraph eller LlamaIndex


Teamet du blir en del av

Du blir en del av vårt team inom Dataanalys & BI med konsulter i både Luleå och Stockholm. Här möter du kollegor som brinner för sitt område, som hjälper varandra att utvecklas och som tillsammans bygger lösningar från ax till limpa.

Området är prioriterat hos oss, och du kommer att spela en viktig roll i teamets fortsatta utveckling. Samtidigt får du en personlig och skräddarsydd utvecklingsresa där du tillsammans med teamet stärker Agios affär och skapar värde för våra kunder.

Varför Agio?

Agio erbjuder dig:
Trygghet genom kollektivavtal och stabila kundrelationer
En arbetsplats som värnar om balans i livet
En personlig kompetensresa där du får utvecklas i din riktning
En platt organisation där du får stort inflytande
Ett företag som satsar långsiktigt både på dig och våra kunder


Vill du växa med oss? Skicka in en ansökan genom att svara på några korta frågor nedan.

Title: Data Scientist - Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
Description:
Jobbeskrivning

Tietos verksamhet inom Data /AI söker nu en data scientist som vill bidra till vår och våra kunders utveckling.

Vi skräddarsyr och optimerar lösningar enligt kundens behov och de teknologier som kan ge dem maximal affärsnytta, där du kan har ett stort inflytande och göra skillnad. Som Data/AI-konsult med inriktningen på data science kommer du att t ex:


Designa, utveckla och underhålla data pipelines och ETL-processer.
Analysera stora mängder strukturerad och ostrukturerad data.
Skapa och underhålla dashboards.
Förstå affärsbehov och leverera datadrivna lösningar.


Hos Tieto finns det stora möjligheter till utveckling. Du får arbeta med meningsfulla projekt i en öppen organisationskultur där kompetensutbyte uppmuntras. Vi återfinns i de flesta branscher i den svenska arbetsmarknaden, och väljer gärna kunder och uppdarg som både utvecklar oss som konsulter och som gynnar samhället i stort.

Kvalifikationer


Minst sex års arbetserfarenhet inom data science och dataanalys.
Flytande svenska och engelska både i tal och skrift.
Universtetsutbildning inom datavetenskap, statistik eller liknande.
Stark kunskap i SQL och Python.
Erfarenhet av molnplattformarna Azure, AWS eller GCP.


Meriterande


Erfarenhet inom data engineering.
Erfarenhet som IT-konsult.
Erfarenhet av plattformarna Databricks, Snowflake och Power BI.
Erfarenhet av maskininlärning och AI.
Erfarenhet av teknologoier och programmering inom Pyspark, Scala, R eller liknande.
Kunskap inom NLP.


Personliga egenskaper

Du är en analytisk och initiativtagande problemlösare. Du brinner för att lösa kundproblem och vill stötta dem på bästa möjliga sätt samtidigt som du utvecklas.

Vi ser fram emot att lära känna just DIG och utforska hur vi tillsammans kan forma framtiden. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Låter det intressant?

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Bifoga ditt CV eller din LinkedIn-profil så kontaktar vi dig. Intervjuer kommer att hållas löpande, så vi uppmuntrar dig att ansöka redan idag!

Vi utför bakgrundskontroller av alla slutkandidater.

Tieto avböjer samtal från rekryteringsföretag.

Om Tieto

Tieto skapar meningsfull teknologi som bidrar till att göra världen bättre. Vi är ett ledande techbolag med lång historia och närvaro i Norden men har också global kapacitet. Baserat på våra kärnvärden öppenhet, trovärdighet och mångfald, jobbar vi tillsammans med våra kunder – och utvecklar en digital framtid där företag, samhällen och människor kan växa.

Våra 24 000 experter globalt specialiserar sig på cloud, data och mjukvara för tusentals företag och organisationer inom privat och offentlig sektor i mer än 90 länder. Tieto omsätter årligen cirka 3 miljarder euro och företagets aktier är noterade på NASDAQ-börsen i Helsingfors och Stockholm samt på Oslo Børs.

Ytterligare information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
TL;DR

We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineer / Data Scientist who loves building and shipping features. You’ll take big ownership of Magma’s AI projects, prototype fast, deploy models to production, and help improve math learning for millions of students. Stockholm-based, full-time, 5 days in office.

About Magma Math

Magma is one of the world’s fastest-growing and most celebrated edtech companies, transforming math education through the power of AI. Our platform turns handwritten solutions into digital insights, empowering teachers to focus on creativity and deeper learning while giving them real-time visibility into student progress.

The result? More inclusive, engaging, and effective math classrooms for all learners.

But we’re not just building better tools. We’re tackling one of the biggest challenges in global education: math underperformance. With 1 in 5 students globally struggling in math, a subject that forms the backbone of so many career paths, we believe the opportunity to improve outcomes at scale is massive.

We’re already the go-to solution in thousands of schools and we’re just getting started. As we expand rapidly across the U.S. and Europe, we’re building a team as ambitious as our mission: to help millions of students unlock their full potential in math.

The Role

We are looking for builders that want to work with large data sets, build AI-powered products and ship things that make a real difference for teachers and students. In this role you will take large ownership of Magma’s AI initiatives, from research and prototyping to production and iteration, working together with product and engineering.

Your Work Will Span Across Areas Such As


Digging into data, building models, pipelines and AI-powered systems
Building AI agents and agentic workflows
Prototyping quickly and iterating based on real classroom feedback and measurable impact
Deploying and monitoring models in production, improving quality, speed and reliability over time
Leverage AI to scale both the product and the business
Working closely with the team to define what “great” looks like for AI in education, and pushing the product forward fast
This is a high-ownership role where you’ll be expected to move quickly, explore new ideas, and turn the best ones into real product improvements that are used by students every day


Who You Are And What You Know

We are searching for a team member who wants to take large ownership of Magma's different AI projects. To succeed you need to:


Be passionate about building stuff with big impact
Have a big interest in AI, stay up-to-date with the latest releases and enjoy experimenting
Be very ambitious and like chasing challenging targets
Be extremely output-oriented and find satisfaction in driving projects to completion
Eager to learn new things, and have experience of building stuff
Great at communicating
Be hardworking and willing to join a fast-paced and rapidly growing startup


Requirements


Coding skills that enable you to build stuff
Strong technical skills
Hands-on experience vibe coding with AI tools
Fluent in English


Our tech stack


Languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript
AI & LLMs: multiple LLM providers, Langfuse for evaluation and observability
Infrastructure: AWS
AI development: Claude Code, Cursor and other AI-native development tools


Our stack evolves quickly and we care more about using the right tools and shipping great systems than any specific framework.

What We Offer


Play a key role in an exciting journey. We are a young company with ambitious targets and meaningful goals
Fantastic colleagues in a fun environment with great opportunities to learn develop your skills
Competitive salary and benefits
An opportunity to work on a meaningful mission and have an exceptional impact on education, society, and how children learn math across the world
Travel and meet users and colleagues around the world


Location: Stockholm, Sweden.

Note: We practice a 5 day in office policy, and we look forward to working together closely with you :)

Our Recruitment Process

A call with the Hiring Manager.

1st interview with Hiring Manager and People team member.

2nd interview with Hiring Manager and Magma team member.

3rd interview with CPO and Magma team member.

Title: Data Analyst / Data Scientist (French speaking)
Description:
About the role




This week CNN and Reuters reported on our work in DRC together with Vodacom, WHO, Congo government, African CDC and other where we are using mobile-phone data to understand population movements and get ahead of the Ebola outbreak. This is part of Flowminder's work, and we need one more person on the team doing it.




You'll turn mobile operator, survey and spatial data into population and mobility statistics that ministries of health, national statistics offices and UN agencies rely on for outbreak response, humanitarian planning and development decision-making in DRC and beyond. About a third of the role is training and building capacity with our partner institutions, in French and English, including travel to the countries we work in. It's a job where what you produce on a Tuesday can shape decisions on the ground by Friday.




We're looking for someone with a strong quantitative background, solid Python and time-series skills, spatial data experience, and professional working French.

Permanent, full-time, based in Stockholm or Southampton (hybrid).

Deadline: 30 September 2026. We review on a rolling basis.




Full details and how to apply: https://lnkd.in/d2eff96M




About Flowminder

Flowminder is a non-profit foundation. We enable decision makers to access the data they need to transform the lives of vulnerable people, at scale.

We analyse pseudonymised mobile operator data, satellite imagery and household survey data to measure where people are and how they move. Flowminder researchers were the first to use mobile operator data to track population movements after a large-scale disaster and during a major infectious disease outbreak, following the 2010 Haiti earthquake and cholera outbreak. We work with national statistics offices, health ministries and disaster management agencies in low- and middle-income countries, alongside UN agencies, the World Bank and development banks.

We are a small team, based mainly in Southampton and Stockholm, working in countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Haiti, Ghana and Pakistan. Our working language is English, but much of our work with partners is in French.

Title: Data Analysis Scientist, Analytical Development
Description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Location/Division Specific Information:

Olink, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, is dedicated to advancing the understanding of human disease through proteomics. Olink panels provide innovative, high-quality solutions for human protein biomarker discovery, enabling researchers to measure thousands of proteins simultaneously from just a few microliters of blood. Using highly specific and thoroughly validated assays with a wide dynamic range, Olink’s technology overcomes traditional limitations in protein analysis and supports deeper insights into human biology and disease.

Job Description

We are seeking a Data Analysis Scientist III to join our R&D organization and the Analytical Development team. The role is based in Uppsala, and you will be reporting to the Manager, Analytical Development.

In this role, you play a key role in developing analytical tools and concepts for QC. You will act as a supporting expert in advanced analysis, as well as working independently identifying critical parameters driving quality. Join our innovative R&D team to make a meaningful impact on scientific advancement!

A day in the Life

You will collaborate cross functionally and contribute to cutting edge projects within proteomics. A key focus will be to perform complex data analysis and present conclusions to guide technical decisions and identify key parameters impacting performance. You will develop analytical tools for quality control (QC) methods, contributing to robust and reliable analytical solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Participate in technical projects and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to develop advanced solutions.
Develop and evaluate analytical tools and concepts.
Perform complex data analysis and identify key parameters influencing performance
Trend data to support trouble shooting as well as identifying and improving QC metrics and limits.
Mentor colleagues and contribute to building team expertise


Education & background


PhD in the life science field, preferably within Bioinformatics.
Strong skills in data analysis, statistical analysis and technical problem solving
Extensive experience in analyzing large data sets in R
Experience in data trending and development of analytical tools, shiny apps or similar
Documented laboratory experience in biochemistry techniques, molecular biology techniques, analytical methods or similar is beneficial.
Experience leading activities and mentoring colleagues.


Soft Skills


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data as well as clearly visualize and communicate conclusions to others.
Strong team player with a proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams.
Strong written and verbal communication abilities to present technical information to diverse audiences.
Excellent organizational and time management skills to handle multiple projects according to set deadlines.
Effective communication skills, preferably in both Swedish and English
Ability to adapt in a dynamic environment


Why Join Us? 

At Olink, Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will be part of a nurturing team that values integrity, innovation, and involvement. We offer an encouraging environment where your diverse experiences and perspectives are appreciated, enabling you to thrive and excel in your career.

The final date for submitting applications is on the 18th of October. The role could be filled prior to this deadline.

Title: Analytiker/Data Scientist inom bidragsbrott till Uppsala
Description:
Placeringsort Flera orterDiarienummer FK 2026/026988

Logga in och sök jobbet Öppnas i nytt fönster

Varje år fattar Försäkringskassan 21 miljoner beslut som påverkar människors liv och hela samhället. Vi betalar ut cirka 260 miljarder kronor varje år. Det är allas skattepengar vi har hand om. Det är ett stort ansvar. Därför sätter vi oss in i varje ärende, följer lagar och regler, informerar och vägleder, bryr oss och visar omtanke. Det är ett jobb för dig som vill vara med och ta ansvar. Välkommen till Försäkringskassan.

Hos oss får du ett varierande och avancerat arbete i en trevlig arbetsmiljö, med goda möjligheter till balans mellan arbete och fritid. Om du också värdesätter ett välfungerande arbete med dina kollegor och vill bli en del av ett samhällsviktigt uppdrag, så kan detta vara tjänsten för dig.

Försäkringskassan har kommit långt i sin tillämpning av analys och AI i syfte att motverka bidragsbrott och felaktiga utbetalningar. Vi arbetar med stora mängder interna och externa data samlat på ett omfattande och strukturerat data warehouse. Vårt datalager är bland de största i Norden.

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta med riskvärdering och programmering. Främst handlar det om att ta fram urval till kontroll men vi arbetar även med att automatisera och förbättra myndighetens handläggning. Du bör ha arbetslivserfarenhet av att hantera, bearbeta och analysera data samt kombinera data från olika källor.

Arbetsuppgifterna innebär bl.a. att ta fram, vidareutveckla och förvalta urval, expertsystem och utredningsstöd i form av webapplikationer tillsammans med t.ex. verksamhetsspecialister och IT. Du kommer jobba främst i SAS EG (low-code) och SAS Viya. För att kunna ha en hög förvaltningsbarhet på våra produkter är det viktigt att arbetet utförs enligt vår arbetsprocess, där man följer den standard och de arbetsrutiner som vi har tagit fram. Detta inkluderar även dokumentation av produkten. Arbetet är omväxlande och du kommer i kontakt med stora delar av Försäkringskassans verksamhet.

Tjänsten innebär att du hanterar sekretessbelagda uppgifter vilket ställer höga krav på rätt hantering. Därför är det viktigt att du som ska arbeta hos oss har högt säkerhetsmedvetande.

Det är ett jobb för dig som vill vara med och ta ansvar.

Vi söker dig som


har högskolexamen inom matematik, statistik, systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, eller annan utbildning som vi bedömer som likvärdig som t.ex. en ingenjörsutbildning
har god erfarenhet av att hantera, bearbeta och analysera data
har erfarenhet av analysarbete med kvantitativa metoder
har goda kunskaper i relevanta analysmetoder och programmeringsspråk som exempelvis SAS och SQL
agerar på eget initiativ och tar ansvar för att nå goda resultat
har ett systematiskt och noggrant arbetssätt
kan förstå och analysera komplexa frågor
samarbetar effektivt med andra för att nå gemensamma mål
har god kommunikativ förmåga.


Det Är Meriterande Om Du


har erfarenhet av avancerad dataanalys
har erfarenhet från arbete inom socialförsäkringen eller annan myndighet
har mycket god erfarenhet av att hantera, bearbeta och analysera data från Försäkringskassans datalager
har erfarenhet av att använda SAS EG, SAS EM, SAS STP eller motsvarande i SAS Viya.


Övrigt

En tjänst, tillsvidare, heltid, med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning kan bli aktuellt. Vissa anställningar hos oss innebär deltagande i säkerhetskänslig verksamhet. För att bli anställd i en sådan tjänst krävs godkänd säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585).

I enlighet med Försäkringskassans riktlinje för säkerhet genomförs bakgrundskontroller i denna rekrytering. Möjlighet till distansarbete finns om arbetet tillåter. I den här rekryteringen kan arbetspsykologiska test och arbetsprov användas som en del i urvalsarbetet. Placeringsort: Stockholm eller Uppsala.

Vill du veta mer om Försäkringskassan som arbetsgivare? Besök fk.se/jobbahososs

Kontaktpersoner

Chef: Pål Wilkens 010-116 22 35 (för frågor om tjänsten). HR-specialist: Fanny Secher, fanny.secher@fk.se (för frågor om rekryteringsprocessen). ST: Henrik Lindholm 010-116 92 35, Saco-S: Annika Linell 010-114 79 54, Seko: Johanna Grundström 010-115 30 44.

Ansökan

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 28 september 2026. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekryteringar, du får istället besvara ett antal urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Ladda upp dina examensbevis, betyg och intyg i samband med din ansökan.

Har du skyddade personuppgifter eller ingen tillgång till bank-id kontaktar du den HR-specialist som finns namngiven i annonsen via telefon så får du hjälp med att skicka in din ansökan.

Vi ska i allt vi gör, agera med utgångspunkt i principen om alla människors lika värde, rättssäkerhet och med god service.

Title: Data Scientist, AI platform
Description:
Nordnet redefined the financial world as the first digital bank in Europe. Now we are about to do it again—this time by putting AI at the heart of our strategy, and you'll embark on a challenging journey alongside a skillful team of sharp and committed colleagues.

We're searching for a Data Scientist to join Nordnet's AIR (AI & Research) function, working embedded within the AI Platform team. Your mission: Enable the rest of the organisation with the best possible AI capabilities.

The Setup

You'll be working alongside platform engineers to tackle the full lifecycle—from exploring possibilities to deploying production features. Our technical foundation is Google Cloud Platform, where we've deployed internal and customer facing GenAI features. Now we're scaling what works and developing new capabilities.

This is not a theoretical role; you're a builder and problem-solver who thrives on iteration. You'll report to our Data Science Manager while working daily with the AI platform team.

What You'll Do


Build and maintain production AI pipelines from experimentation through deployment and monitoring.
Collaborate with engineers throughout the development cycle—you'll work together on architecture and implementation in an iterative fashion.
Drive quality through evaluation, metrics, and testing of AI solutions.
Champion AI Governance - Ensure compliance with the bank's regulatory framework by clarifying AI concepts and risks


This is you

You take pride in your work and are driven by curiosity—you want to continuously learn and grow.

You Likely Have


Experience with LLMs, GenAI and agentic AI
Python skills for both exploration and production code.
SQL proficiency for data analysis and pipeline building.
Knowledge of ML/AI evaluation, metrics, and best practices.
Experience with ML/AI in cloud environments (GCP experience is a plus).
Knowledge of MLOps
Experience with IaC (terraform).


We Also Get Excited If You Have


Experience working embedded.
Experience with Go and/or Java.
Comfort presenting technical work to diverse audiences.


We think that you have 3+ years experience working as a Data Scientist, ML Engineer or AI Engineer with a University degree in data science, computer science, mathematics, engineering or similar field.

We offer


Work in a product-focused environment with direct impact
Growth opportunities as a data scientist in a fast-moving AI space
Competitive salary and compensation


You'll work in a Nordic environment with high ambitions and a strong focus on delivery, product development, and technology.

Title: Entry Level: Data Scientist
Description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Are you a recent graduate passionate about AI and the new technologies in this area? Join our Ericsson Radio Software AI Team planning, introducing and promoting today’s and future AI technologies. To achieve our goals, we collaborate closely with internal and external partners, to introduce the state of the art AI technology and enhance the Radio Product Development beyond current capabilities.

You’ll be part of a team of about 5 colleagues with a mix of junior and senior experience and diverse backgrounds. We are also working together with teams from Vietnam and Türkiye, to operate our AI Infrastructure and Data platform. As a new graduate, you’ll be encouraged to explore these areas, and we’ll align your responsibilities with your interests and development goals.

What you will do:


Operate the RUSW AWS account and support AI workloads across cloud and on-premises environments.
Collaborate with the Data Platform team to enable AI access to semantic layers, knowledge graphs, metadata, and enterprise data products.
Establish AI evaluation capabilities, including benchmarks, test datasets, quality metrics, and regression testing.
Manage the lifecycle of AI agents and models, including versioning, rollout, rollback, experimentation, and retirement.
Help transform existing workflows into AI-native processes.
Design context-engineering and knowledge-management practices that enable agents to use reliable, up-to-date information.


The skills you bring:


A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or a related field, with a strong interest in generative AI and agentic systems.
Knowledge of cloud and platform engineering, preferably AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code.
Understanding of distributed systems, APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, or workflow orchestration.
Interest in knowledge graphs, ontologies, vector databases, semantic APIs, and retrieval-augmented generation.
Familiarity with agent engineering concepts such as multi-agent systems, tool calling, MCP, LangGraph, or human-in-the-loop workflows is an advantage.
Experience or interest in LLMs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI.
Strong analytical, collaborative, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and learn quickly.


Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.

At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join our Resins & Technology Data Science R&D team located in Uppsala, Sweden. This role is a 1 year temporary position.

As a Data Scientist, you will support product development from idea generation to production transfer. In this role you will help to discover, design, and implement scientific workflows and data-driven use cases across R&D, including development of data pipelines, advanced analytics, and AI/ML solutions. This role sits at the intersection of science, data engineering, and data science, working closely with researchers, domain experts, and platform teams to turn experimental data into reliable, reusable, and scalable assets.

You will play a key role throughout the full lifecycle of scientific use cases, from early discovery and feasibility assessment, through design and proof-of-concept, to production-grade implementation and adoption. Perform data analysis, troubleshoot development projects, and develop, implement, and tune predictive models.

What You'll Do


Support experimental design (DoE) and planning
Drive and foster a data-driven culture within R&D
Work with R&D SMEs to understand scientific workflows and identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and AI/ML
Design and document maintainable solutions and data flows in collaboration with stakeholders and IT architects
Develop applications, tools, and interfaces that help researchers access, visualize, and analyze data efficiently
Support production deployment, monitoring, and operation with IT, DevOps, and platform teams
Document and present results clearly, both orally and in writing
Identify and implement relevant new techniques while following technical developments in the field


Who You Are


Master's degree in a technical discipline with expert competency in data science/data engineering/bioinformatics or equal experience
Proficient in Python, comfortable with R
Proficient in explorative data analysis, cleaning, and transformation
Experience with modern AI/ML techniques
Experience in the SQL language and databases
Experience with solutions for data management
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and Azure) and their data services
Knowledge of version control/Git
Well versed in multivariate statistics and predictive modelling .


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:


Experience with image analysis and/or computer vision
Experience with protein/DNA sequence alignment methodologies
Experience in Design of Experiments (DoE)
Experience with Web development
Experience with DevOps and CI/CD
Practical wet lab experience and experience with analytical chemistry


This is an onsite role and we therefore see that you who apply are resident in Uppsala or a nearby area with the flexibility to commute from our site on a daily basis

Interviews and selection will take place on an ongoing basis, so please do not wait to submit your application to us.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

Title: Advanced Analytics Expert
Description:
Vill du vara med och bygga upp nästa steg i ATG:s analysförmåga? Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera avancerad analys, statistik och affärsförståelse för att hjälpa hela organisationen att fatta bättre beslut. Vi söker nu en Advanced Analytics Expert som vill ta sig an komplexa frågeställningar, utveckla nya analysmetoder och skapa insikter som gör verklig skillnad. Här får du arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan data, affär och strategi, samtidigt som du är med och formar hur avancerad analys ska användas på ATG framåt.




I rollen får du:

Bygga upp och utveckla ATG:s centrala förmåga inom avancerad analys.
Utveckla och vidareutveckla analysmetoder inom områden som medieeffektivitet, attribution och statistisk modellering.
Kombinera data från flera olika källor såsom webbdata, CRM, NPS, undersökningsdata, kundservice och mediedata för att skapa nya insikter.
Designa och utveckla skalbara analytiska ramverk och produkter som används av flera delar av verksamheten.
Fungera som specialist och rådgivare i komplexa analys- och metodfrågor för analysorganisationen.
Driva metodutveckling och bidra till att höja den analytiska mognaden inom ATG.
Samarbeta nära kollegor inom analys, data, marknad och andra affärsområden.
Bidra till att skapa bättre beslutsunderlag kring bland annat marknadsinvesteringar, kundupplevelse och affärsutveckling.
Utforska nya metoder, modeller och arbetssätt för att identifiera samband och effekter som inte fångas av traditionell analys.




Är det här du?

Vi söker dig som har ett starkt analytiskt driv och som trivs när du får ta dig an komplexa frågeställningar där svaren inte är självklara. Du har en djup metodförståelse och tycker om att kombinera statistik, modellering och affärsförståelse för att skapa värde. Samtidigt är du prestigelös och samarbetsorienterad. Du uppskattar att dela med dig av din kunskap, utmana etablerade arbetssätt och hjälpa andra att förstå avancerade analyser på ett enkelt och pedagogiskt sätt. Du är nyfiken på verksamheten bakom siffrorna och vill förstå hur analys kan bidra till bättre beslut, effektivare investeringar och starkare kundupplevelser. Du trivs i en roll där du får vara expert, samtidigt som du arbetar nära andra funktioner och tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt.




Vi ser att du har:

Flera års erfarenhet av avancerad analys, data science, analytics eller liknande område.
Mycket goda kunskaper i Python.
Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL.
Erfarenhet av statistisk modellering och kvantitativ analys.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med och kombinera flera olika datakällor.
Erfarenhet av att utveckla modeller, analysramverk eller andra skalbara analytiska lösningar.
Förmåga att omsätta komplex analys till tydliga rekommendationer och beslutsunderlag.
Erfarenhet av att driva analysinitiativ från idé till implementation.




Meriterande:

Erfarenhet av avancerad analys inom områden som medieeffektivitet, attribution, Marketing Science, MMM, varumärkesanalys eller kundlivsvärdesmodellering.
Erfarenhet av experimentdesign, kausala analyser eller andra metoder för att förstå effekten av olika affärs- och marknadsinsatser.
Erfarenhet av att bygga skalbara analytiska produkter och ramverk som används av flera delar av verksamheten.
Erfarenhet från en datadriven miljö där analys spelar en central roll i affärsutveckling och beslutsfattande.




We are the game

I mer än 50 år har vi på ATG levererat spänning och underhållning till svenska folket. Vi drivs av att trygga den svenska hästnäringen och att fortsatt vara ett ansvarsfullt spelbolag i framkant. Vår vision är att leverera världens bästa spelupplevelse. Vi gillar att samarbeta och uppmuntrar varandra att tänka och testa nytt. Självledarskap och kompetensutveckling är viktiga delar för oss. Vi bryr oss om varandra och våra kunder och vi vill så klart också att alla tävlingshästar ska må bra. Hela vårt överskott går till hästnäringen – något som både känns och gör gott.




Join the game!

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via vår rekryteringsportal antingen med ditt cv eller din LinkedIn-profil – det som är enklast och smidigast för dig. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår karriärsida och tveka inte att höra av dig om du har frågor om tjänsten.




Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning och kommer att göra en bakgrundskontroll för denna roll. Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor vid Solvalla, alldeles intill travbanan. Vi har ett flexibelt arbetssätt vilket innebär att du har möjlighet att kombinera distansarbete med arbete från kontoret. Var med och bygg världens bästa spelupplevelse tillsammans med oss!

Title: Forskare inom AI och intelligenta informationssystem
Description:
FOI-PERS-2026-893

Vill du arbeta med utmanande tillämpningar inom AI-området för att stärka totalförsvaret på både kort och lång sikt? Har du forskat inom maskininlärning och intelligenta informationssystem och är intresserad av hur de kan stödja analys och beslutsfattande? Då kan FOI vara din nya arbetsplats. Vi erbjuder ett arbetsliv i balans, en utvecklande arbetsmiljö och ett samhällsviktigt arbete.


Om tjänsten


Som forskare kommer du att arbeta med utveckling av AI-baserade metoder och tekniker – exempelvis inom maskininlärning, informationsfusion och beslutsstöd – för att stärka informationshantering och beslutsfattande inom totalförsvaret. Du kommer att ansvara för problemformulering, metodval och metodutveckling, planering av forskning, genomförande och analys av datorexperiment samt dokumentation av resultat i rapporter, vetenskapliga artiklar eller som konferensbidrag. Förutom att presentera resultaten för våra uppdragsgivare kan det i arbetet även ingå att omsätta forskningsresultaten i konkreta AI-tillämpningar.


Om enheten


Du kommer att ingå i någon av enheterna inom verksamhetsområde Ledningssystem, som tillhör avdelningen Cyberförsvar och ledningsteknik. Doktorsexamen inom datalogi, datavetenskap eller närliggande områden.
